title: Specialist Solutions Architect - AI/ML
description:
**Job Description**
As an AI/ML Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will be the trusted technical ML & AI expert to both Databricks customers and the Field Engineering organization. You will work with Solution Architects to guide customers in architecting production-grade ML & AI applications on Databricks, while aligning their technical roadmap with the continually evolving Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will continue to strengthen your technical skills through applying cutting-edge technologies in GenAI, MLOps, and ML more broadly, expanding your impact through mentorship, and establishing yourself as an AI thought leader.
  
  
This is a Hybrid role, based in Mumbai.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* Architect production-level ML & AI workloads for customers using our unified platform, including agents, end-to-end ML pipelines, training/inference optimization, integration with cloud-native services, MLOps, etc.
* Serve as a trusted practitioner for enterprise GenAI solutions, including RAG architectures, agentic systems (tool-calling agents, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails), natural language querying of structured data, AI evaluation and observability, and monitoring systems
* Build, scale, and optimize customer AI workloads and apply best-in-class MLOps to productionize these workloads across a variety of domains
* Provide advanced technical support to Solution Architects during the technical sale, ranging from feature engineering, training, tracking, serving, to model monitoring, all within a single platform, as well as participating in the larger ML SME community in Databricks
* Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to represent the voice of the customer, define priorities, and influence the product roadmap, helping with the adoption of Databricks’ AI offerings

What we look for
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on industry ML experience in at least one of the following:
* ML Engineer: Build and maintain production-grade cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) infrastructure that supports the deployment of ML applications, including drift monitoring.
* AI Engineer: Experience with the latest techniques in LLMs & agentic systems, including vector databases, fine-tuning LLMs, AI guardrail systems, and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI
* Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
* Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike
* Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through ML & AI
* [Preferred] 2+ years customer-facing experience in a pre-sales or post-sales role
* Can meet expectations for technical training and role-specific outcomes within 3 months of hire
* Can travel up to 30% when needed

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance
  
  
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Senior Engineer, AI Platform Engineering
description:
*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
**PRIMARY FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES**
**AI Engineering**

* Design, develop, test, and operate production-grade AI services and applications.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested production code using Python and modern software engineering practices.
* Develop APIs, services, libraries, and reusable components that support AI applications across the firm.
* Participate in technical design, code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Work with senior engineers to implement platform architecture, engineering standards, and reusable design patterns.
* Own defined engineering components and workstreams from development through deployment and ongoing operation.

**Generative AI & Shared AI Services**

* Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation capabilities using embeddings, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, vector databases, document processing, and structured data retrieval.
* Develop reusable services for document extraction, search, retrieval, and AI-powered workflows.
* Build agentic and multi-step workflows incorporating model reasoning, tools, enterprise data, and application services.
* Implement prompt templates, structured outputs, tool-use patterns, and reusable orchestration components.
* Build integrations using Model Context Protocol and other AI interoperability patterns where appropriate.
* Contribute to evaluation frameworks for measuring retrieval quality, generation accuracy, workflow performance, and overall AI-system quality.
* Experiment with emerging models, frameworks, retrieval techniques, and AI engineering approaches and help translate successful experiments into production capabilities.

**AI Platform Development**

* Contribute to enterprise AI gateway capabilities supporting model access, routing, resiliency, usage tracking, and cost management.
* Develop common APIs and SDKs that make AI platform capabilities easy for other engineering teams to consume.
* Support prompt management, model configuration, model lifecycle, and deployment capabilities.
* Integrate AI services with enterprise data products, applications, APIs, and internal systems.
* Help build reusable tooling and reference implementations that accelerate development by application and vertical engineering teams.
* Support platform capabilities for tracing, observability, usage attribution, and AI FinOps.

**Application Enablement**

* Partner with AI Product Management, Data Engineering, and business-aligned technology teams to translate business requirements into working technical solutions.
* Develop application-specific AI workflows and integrations using shared enterprise AI platform services.
* Enable secure connectivity between AI applications, enterprise systems, and governed data sources.
* Help develop AI capabilities supporting workflows across investment and corporate functions.
* Work directly with engineers and product teams to troubleshoot issues, improve solution quality, and move AI use cases into production.
* Create documentation, examples, and reusable patterns that help other teams successfully adopt shared AI capabilities.

**DevOps, Reliability & Observability**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI applications and services.
* Develop automated testing for software components, prompts, retrieval pipelines, and AI workflows.
* Implement monitoring, telemetry, logging, tracing, and operational-health capabilities.
* Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Support deployment processes, rollback mechanisms, production-support models, and reliability standards.
* Monitor application and service performance, latency, quality, usage, and cost.

**Security, Risk & Governance**

* Follow secure engineering practices for authentication, authorization, secrets management, encryption, and data access.
* Implement entitlement-aware access to enterprise data and AI services.
* Partner with senior engineers to meet cybersecurity, data-protection, information-barrier, and AI governance requirements.
* Contribute documentation and technical evidence required for architecture, security, and governance reviews.
* Build solutions consistent with the firm's engineering, cybersecurity, regulatory, compliance, and risk-management standards.

**Collaboration & Engineering Culture**

* Collaborate closely with AI engineers, data engineers, product managers, application developers, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders.
* Participate actively in design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering planning.
* Share knowledge and reusable patterns with other engineers.
* Help improve engineering standards, development practices, documentation, and tooling.
* Demonstrate a strong ownership mindset and a focus on software quality, simplicity, reliability, and continuous learning.

**Qualifications**
**Education**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  
  
**Experience Required**

* 4 to 8 years of professional software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, or related experience.
* Hands-on experience developing machine learning, Generative AI, LLM, or data-intensive applications.
* Strong Python development skills and experience writing production-quality software.
* Experience designing or consuming APIs, services, and cloud-based applications.
* Experience with a major cloud platform, preferably Azure.
* Practical experience with one or more Generative AI techniques such as RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, structured generation, tool use, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with modern software development practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and production monitoring.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Ability to take ownership of defined technical components and deliver them from design through production.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Model Serving, MLflow, or Vector Search.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI services, OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable enterprise LLM providers.
* Experience with LLM application or agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or comparable technologies.
* Experience building RAG applications, document-processing pipelines, semantic or hybrid search, or vector-search solutions.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol, function calling, tool-use patterns, or agent interoperability standards.
* Experience with model or application evaluation, including automated evaluation or LLM-as-judge approaches.
* Experience with LLM observability, tracing, production monitoring, or AI cost-management practices.
* Experience building applications against governed enterprise data.
* Experience working in financial services or another regulated environment.
* Asset management, private equity, investment banking, or alternative investments experience.

**Reporting Relationships**
Head of Data and Analytics
  
  
*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Gen AI - Senior

title: Backend Engineer (IoT & Security)
description:
**About us

We're an early stage startup in stealth mode in Mumbai, building a security first service that protects people's most valuable possessions. At its core is a secure, connected device that we design in house.

The role

Our core promise: only the customer can open what they've trusted us with. Not our staff, and not even us. We're hiring the engineer who will own the software that keeps that promise.

What you'll do

• Design and build the backend: accounts, device registration, secure commands to the device and a tamper-evident audit log

• Own the security model end to end, including key management, so that no master key exists

• Build the first version of the customer app

• Work with our hardware engineer on how the device talks to our servers, including firmware updates

• Set up the cloud infrastructure and monitoring we'll launch on

• Move fast with AI coding tools, and catch what they get wrong in security-critical code

What you'll bring

• 3+ years building and running production backends in Node.js, Python or Go

• Strong on authentication and authorisation: signed tokens, public key cryptography, key storage and rotation

• Experience with APIs for IoT or hardware devices (MQTT, WebSockets or similar)

• PostgreSQL or a similar database, and AWS, GCP or Azure

Good to have

• React Native or Flutter

• HSMs, a cloud KMS or secure elements

• Fintech, payments or security products

How we work

• Contract for the prototype phase, with a path to a full-time role. Full-time preferred; we'll consider an exceptional part-timer

• Competitive pay, all in cash (no ESOPs)

• Mumbai-based, working on-site with the hardware team

• You work directly with the founder, and what you build is what ships

Please apply only if you've built or owned cryptographic key management in a production system. Shortlisted candidates will walk us through a system they built and how they secured it.**

title: Staff Engineer - Platform
description:
**About SolarSquare :**

At SolarSquare we are building the Home-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full-stack D2C residential solar brand - designing, installing, maintaining (after-sales), and financing solar systems for home-owners across India.

In a few short years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service, and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.

**About the role :**

As a Staff Engineer on Platform, you own the developer and infrastructure platform the entire engineering org builds on - cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and the internal tooling that eliminates mundane, repeated work. You set the direction for how we run software at scale, and you stay hands-on doing it.

**What you'll own :**

- Design and operate a cloud-native platform (Kubernetes-based) and the paved-road tooling teams build on.

- Own CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and developer experience - automate the mundane so engineers focus on impact.

- Drive reliability and SRE practices : observability, incident response, and root-cause fixes that stick.

- Optimize for performance, cost, and security as first-class concerns across the platform.

- Build internal developer-platform capabilities and standards that make the right way the easy way; mentor across pods.

**Tech Stack :**
We run on AWS with Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Redis, and Kafka.

**What we're looking for :**

- 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, with deep distributed-systems fundamentals.

- Expertise in cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.

- Strong observability and reliability practice across service boundaries; you measure, then improve.

- A track record building internal platforms or developer tooling that others adopt.

- Attention to performance, cost, and security as first-class concerns.

- Customer-obsessed and impact-led : you start from the customer's pain and judge yourself by the metric your work moves, not the tickets you close.

- High agency : you don't wait to be told - you spot problems, pick them up, and own the outcome through to production.

- Craft over shortcuts : you fix root causes rather than symptoms, clear tech debt as you go, and don't ship bugs.

- Bias for speed and simplicity : you build once for reuse, automate the mundane, and let AI draft the first pass so your judgment goes where it matters.

- Data-driven : you reach for evidence over assumptions and let results guide the next decision.

**Bonus points :**

- Experience with internal developer platforms (IDP), self-service infrastructure, or DevEx initiatives.

- Cost-optimization or large-scale reliability engineering experience.

- Comfort building automation and agents that remove operational toil.

**Why you'll love building here :**

- Direct ownership of high-impact initiatives with visible customer and business outcomes.

- An AI-native engineering culture with first-class tooling and internal agents.

- A high-agency, low-bureaucracy environment where you debate what's right and ship.

- A meritocracy where growth and recognition track impact, not tenure.

- Competitive compensation.

- A front-row seat to putting clean energy on millions of Indian rooftops.

title: Associate Manager - SAP-SAP S4 HANA ABAP

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – Data Platforms
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Digital and Technology team of General Mills India Centre is looking for MS SQL Server / Cloud database administrator (DBA) with Operations-oriented skill sets to support Cloud/On Prem databases. This opportunity is in a fast-paced environment as we migrate and refactor enterprise scale databases from our on-premises datacenters to cloud environment. Have experience operating in a fast-paced, complex, and multi-platform environment.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Technical leadership for migrating existing MS SQL Server and No SQL Databases to Public Cloud.
* Migrating databases to GCP or any public cloud
* Development and ownership of migration processes, documentation, and tooling
* Expertly administer and manage mission-critical, complex, and high-volume Database Platforms in a 24/7 environment
* SQL Server administration, implementing best practices and resolving complex performance issues
* Setting up PostgreSQL, MySQL and NoSQL DBs (MongoDB) its maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Adhere to cloud security standards or best practices to avoid security breaches and reduce system vulnerability.
* Scripting and Automation
* Implementation and support of AlwaysOn and Failover Clustering.
* Database support lifecycle activities.
* Collaborate cross function to resolve tickets.
* Collaborate with application stakeholders.
* Have exposure of working within Agile framework.

description:

From airplane engines to hydraulic systems, scotch to smartphones, OLED screens to paper—everyday Pall is there, helping protect critical operating assets, improve product quality, minimize emissions and waste, and safeguard health. The
**SAP BTP Integration Architect**
owns the architecture, engineering standards, and technical governance for integrations across Pall's global SAP and non-SAP landscape. The role leads secure, scalable integration design on SAP Business Technology Platform, with particular focus on SAP S/4HANA, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, business applications, external partners, and government e-invoicing platforms.
  
  
This position reports to the IT Director, Enterprise Applications and is part of the global Information Technology team. The role is based in India, and will operate in a onsite work model, subject to local site requirements.
  
  
**In this role you will have the opportunity to**

* Define and maintain the enterprise integration strategy and architecture, including standards, principles, reusable patterns, and governance using SAP Integration Suite and SAP best practices.
* Lead end-to-end integration architecture and solution design across SAP Integration Suite capabilities, selecting the appropriate API, event-driven, synchronous, asynchronous, batch, file, and B2B/EDI approaches based on business needs.
* Architect secure integrations across the SAP and enterprise technology landscape, including SAP S/4HANA, DRC, Ariba, BTP solutions, third-party applications, suppliers, customers, and government platforms.
* Establish integration, API, event, and security governance, including identity and access, authentication, authorization, encryption, versioning, lifecycle management, reuse, privacy, and segregation of duties.
* Enable AI-assisted and emerging technology solutions, including Joule and Joule Studio, by providing secure APIs, events, business context, appropriate controls, observability, and human oversight.
* Ensure integration reliability, compliance, and modernization, including monitoring, error handling, performance, service levels, clean-core alignment, regulatory requirements, global e-invoicing, and migration of legacy interfaces such as SAP PI/PO.
* Provide technical leadership and oversight, including architecture reviews, design documentation, technical risk assessments, partner deliverables, developer/consultant mentoring, complex issue resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10+ years of SAP architecture experience, including at least 5 years delivering solutions on SAP BTP, with hands-on experience with Joule.
* Demonstrated leadership of complex SAP transformation programs, including at least three end-to-end SAP BTP integration implementations or comparable enterprise initiatives.
* Deep expertise in SAP Integration Suite and BTP architecture, including Cloud Integration, API Management, event-driven integration, hybrid connectivity, identity services, environments and runtimes, monitoring, CI/CD, and secure operations.
* Strong SAP and enterprise integration expertise, including integration of SAP S/4HANA with SAP and non-SAP platforms using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, RFC, SFTP, messaging technologies, XML, JSON, XSLT, and Groovy.
* Experience designing secure, reliable, and AI-enabled enterprise integrations, including Joule/AI agents, API and tool access, authorization, auditability, OAuth 2.0, SAML, certificates, mutual TLS, exception handling, performance, availability, and responsible AI controls.
* Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to translate business, technical, security, and compliance requirements into architecture decisions and lead internal teams and external partners through design, build, testing, deployment, hyper care, and operational transition.

**Travel**

* Up to 20 percent travel, including international travel, based on project and deployment needs.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in**

* SAP Integration Advisor, Trading Partner Management, Advanced Event Mesh, SAP Cloud ALM, or comparable observability and service-management tooling.
* Current SAP certification in Integration Suite, BTP solution architecture, or a closely related discipline.

title: Senior Architect - MDM
description:
**Job Overview**
The Senior Architect will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the overall architecture of our IT systems to support the organization's current and future needs. The Senior Architect will have a strong background in IT infrastructure, systems integration, and software development, with the ability to analyze complex problems and design innovative solutions. He/she will be responsible for providing strategic direction, designing complex IT solutions, and mentoring junior architects. This architect will be responsible for designing enterprise data models, defining metadata and governance standards, analyzing data quality issues, implementing MDM matching and survivorship strategies, evaluating emerging technologies, and enabling AI-driven automation across the enterprise data ecosystem. Working closely with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Stewards, and Business SMEs, the architect will translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions that improve data quality, governance, discoverability, and business value.
  
  
**Summary Of Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain the organization's IT architecture framework, ensuring alignment with business objectives, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.
* Serve as the hands-on technical architect and subject matter expert for Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Data Catalog, and AI-enabled data management platforms.
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise data architecture standards, canonical data models, metadata frameworks, and governance practices that promote trusted, discoverable, and reusable data assets.
* Lead technical design and configuration of MDM solutions, including data modeling, matching, survivorship, hierarchy management, and integration patterns across critical business domains.
* Analyze enterprise data quality issues through data profiling, root cause analysis, quality assessments, and measurement frameworks; define remediation strategies and business rules to improve data reliability and compliance.
* Architect and optimize enterprise Data Catalog and Metadata Management capabilities, including business glossary, lineage, classification, stewardship, and metadata enrichment processes.
* Identify and implement AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation capabilities to enhance data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, metadata enrichment, entity resolution, stewardship workflows, and governance operations.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to architecture and development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements.
* Design end-to-end IT solutions, including infrastructure, applications, data, and security components, to support business processes and workflows.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance the organization's IT capabilities and drive innovation.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide guidance to development teams to ensure adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate architectural risks and issues through proactive planning and effective communication with stakeholders.
* Define and maintain documentation related to IT architecture, including diagrams, standards, policies, and procedures.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IT architecture, and apply knowledge to drive continuous improvement.
* Measurably impact company performance by delivering high quality, scalable data products.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

* Strong expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-scale IT solutions across multiple platforms and technologies.
* Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data architecture, Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Catalog, MDM, or related data management solutions.
* Must have experience implementing data solutions in Microsoft Azure
* In-depth knowledge of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their services.
* Proficiency in system integration techniques, including API design, microservices architecture, and message queuing protocols.

* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.

title: Data Collection Transformation - Senior Associate
description:

title: Agentic AI Builder
description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today, our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We are optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide from offices in many countries. Our AI and Data teams combine data science, generative AI, and engineering to take solutions from proof of concept to large-scale deployment.

Our Mumbai office launched in 2024. We are building the team with people who want to shape something from the ground up, combining the agility of a start-up with the backing and reach of a global brand. The AI Factory in Mumbai builds and delivers production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients across North America, Europe and the Middle East.

**Job Description**

Generative AI is moving from assistants that answer questions to agents that do work. The Agentic AI Builder designs, builds and industrialises AI agents and multi-agent workflows for Sia's enterprise clients, and helps users adopt them. You will turn real business processes into agents that perform reliably in production.
  
  
This is agent engineering, not prompt writing or chatbot configuration. You will work with Forward Deployed Engineers, architects, consultants, and client teams, and you are expected to reason about orchestration, state, tools, evaluation, security, and cost, and to show with tests and measurements that an agent works.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with consultants and business teams to identify agent use cases and translate business processes into clear agent requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Design agent architectures for business workflows, deciding when a single agent, a multi-agent pattern or a deterministic workflow with LLM steps is the right choice.
* Implement orchestration, tool calling and control flow in Python using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, the Claude Agent SDK or OpenAI SDK, or custom code where that is the better choice.
* Build tools and connectors to enterprise APIs and data sources, including MCP servers, with clear schemas, error handling and permissioning.
* Engineer context deliberately: retrieval over enterprise data, prompt and context design, and state and memory management across steps and sessions.
* Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints for approvals, escalation and exception handling.
* Create evaluation suites covering task success, tool-use correctness, regressions and adversarial cases, and use them to guide each release.
* Add observability, including traces, token and cost tracking and failure analytics, and optimise for reliability, latency and cost.
* Implement guardrails such as input and output validation, scoped credentials, prompt-injection defenses, and data-access controls.
* Work in agile, iterative cycles: estimate effort, flag risks and dependencies early, run solution demonstrations, and document agent behaviour and limits.
* Prepare agents for production with the FDE and architecture team, including deployment, monitoring, and operational handover.

**Internal Contributions**
  
As part of the AI Factory, you will also:

* Package reusable tools, connectors, and agent patterns that speed up later projects.
* Contribute to internal accelerators, demonstrations, and proposals.
* Share knowledge on agent design, evaluation, and guardrails with the wider engineering team.

**Qualifications**

**Education and experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 to 6 years of software or AI engineering experience.
* At least one agent or LLM workflow delivered beyond proof of concept, with evidence of how it was tested and measured.
* Professional English, written and spoken.

**Technical skills (required)**

* Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, packaging, typing and asynchronous programming.
* Hands-on experience building agents with tool calling and orchestration using at least one agent framework or SDK (LangGraph, LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI SDK or equivalent). Experience with every named framework is not expected.
* Understanding of agent state, memory and control flow, including retries, timeouts and failure recovery.
* Practical experience with RAG and vector search, and with context and prompt engineering as part of a larger system.
* Experience evaluating LLM and agent behaviour with test sets, automated checks or LLM-as-judge methods.
* Familiarity with LLM observability and tracing, and with tracking cost and latency.
* Experience integrating agents with enterprise APIs, databases or SaaS applications.
* Awareness of agent-specific risks, including prompt injection, excessive tool permissions and data leakage, and how guardrails address them.
* Cloud deployment fundamentals: containers, environment configuration and CI/CD.

**Consulting and collaboration**

* Ability to explain technical decisions and limits clearly to engineers, architects, and non-technical colleagues. Comfort running solution demonstrations and gathering feedback from business users.
* Ownership of the components you build and the ability to work with geographically distributed teams.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building or hosting an MCP server.
* Experience with multi-agent patterns such as planner and executor, supervisor, or handoff designs.
* Experience with automation platforms such as n8n or Microsoft Copilot Studio alongside code-first approaches.
* Exposure to model routing, fine-tuning, or model selection trade-offs.
* FastAPI or other backend service experience; Kubernetes and infrastructure as code basics.Experience in a regulated sector or collaboration with international teams and clients.

**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on production AI for global enterprise clients, as part of a growing AI engineering capability.
* The chance to learn through real client implementations and to build reusable agent assets for the AI Factory.
* Access to Sia's leadership and training programmes as you grow.
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team working across varied projects and industries.

**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)
  
  
  
  
Equal Opportunity**
  
Sia is an equal opportunity employer. Decisions on hiring, promotion, remuneration and discipline are made solely on performance, competence, conduct and business needs.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

title: Lead Quantitative Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
  
  
In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005), Hong Kong (2007), Shanghai (2012) and Singapore (2021). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are looking for multiple experienced Quantitative Engineers to lead our strategy technology teams in India, focused on building trading strategies for Indian markets and beyond.
  
  
In this role you will work closely with traders and researchers, driving the design and delivery of quantitative trading systems. These systems will be deployed across Indian exchanges (NSE, BSE, MCX) and other APAC exchanges traded by Optiver. You will work at the intersection of trading and technology, shaping the architecture of Optiver’s expansion into systematic strategies.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You will be expected to lead by example. As a technical lead you will mentor and guide other members of the team.
  
  
You won’t be doing this in isolation - you’ll collaborate closely with established teams in Sydney, while contributing to Optiver’s broader strategy across APAC.
  
  
Our engineers own problems end-to-end - from understanding trading challenges to designing, implementing, testing, and deploying solutions into live markets. Development is fast-paced and impactful, with features often reaching production within days.
  
  
**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Design and implement quantitative trading systems. This will include C++ auto-traders plus tooling for traders and researchers.
* Mentor a team of high-performance engineers.
* Partner with trading and research to improve trading systems.
* Drive a culture of engineers focused on the trading problem.
* Contribute to the strategy and vision for Optiver’s Asia Pacific systematic trading capability.
* Drive robustness and quality through strong engineering practices, including code reviews, testing, and production monitoring.
* Collaborate across global teams to share knowledge and influence broader system design.

**Who You Are**
We’re looking for an experienced quantitative engineer with a proven ability to successfully partner with traders and researchers on challenging trading problems. You should have:
  
  
  

* 8+ years of experience as a Quantitative Engineer working closely with traders and researchers.
* Experience making architectural decisions for quantitative trading systems.
* Proven ability to solve technically challenging problems, with a pragmatic and results-driven mindset.
* Experience applying machine learning techniques to trading.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with trading, research, and other business teams.
* Experience leading projects as a technical owner, driving delivery and influencing design decisions.

If you have any of these, we’re even more excited to hear from you:
  
  
  

* Experience working on systematic strategies for options products within a similar trading firm.
* Experience directly leading a team.

**What You'll Get**

* A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.

Optiver is committed to
  
  
diversity and inclusion
  
  
  
  
We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via
  
  
careers@optiver.com.au

We are looking for an experienced SAP Event Management (EM) Consultant with 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SAP EM configuration, implementation, and integration with SAP Transportation Management (TM), SAP ECC, and SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in supply chain visibility, event tracking, milestone monitoring, and exception handling.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Configuration: Configure expected and unexpected events, event handlers, and rule sets within SAP Event Management (SAP EM) in integration with SAP TM and SAP ECC.
* System Integration: Integrate SAP EM with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Transportation Management (TM), and SAP ECC using IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and SAP BTP.
* Event & Milestone Tracking: Monitor end-to-end transportation processes and track real-time operational events against predefined milestones and benchmarks.
* Exception Management: Identify, monitor, and resolve unexpected events, delays, and transportation exceptions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with supply chain, logistics, and technical teams to improve transportation visibility and operational efficiency.
* Reporting: Utilize standard SAP EM reporting tools to provide event tracking, milestone status, and exception reports.
* Testing & Support: Prepare functional specifications, execute test cases, troubleshoot integration and interface issues, and provide production and go-live support.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  
  

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SAP Event Management (SAP EM).
* Strong knowledge of SAP EM configuration, event handlers, expected events, unexpected events, and rule sets.
* Experience integrating SAP EM with SAP TM, SAP ECC, and SAP S/4HANA.
* Good understanding of SAP integration technologies, including:

+ IDocs
+ RFCs
+ BAPIs
+ SAP BTP

* Strong understanding of supply chain visibility and transportation processes.
* Experience in milestone tracking, event monitoring, and exception handling.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications and support testing activities.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in SAP TM and logistics execution processes.
* Exposure to end-to-end transportation lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration and implementation projects.
* Experience in SAP EM production support and go-live activities.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Financial / Accounting)
description:
**Title: Senior Backend Engineer**

**Location: Goregaon East, Mumbai**

**Job Type: Full time**

**If you are interested please do share me your updated resume to jyothim@aptask.com**

We are looking for a hands-on backend engineer who has personally built and owned a complex, data-correct financial application, and can do it again.

The product is an AI-assisted workbench for fund controllers. Think trial balances, multi-step approval workflows, reconciliation agents, and numbers that become booked accounting entries

downstream.

**Ideal domains:**

* Alternative asset management: private equity, private credit, real assets, hedge funds
* Fund accounting, fund administration, portfolio accounting
* Corporate accounting, ERP, general ledger, close-management software
* Banking, capital markets, BFSI broadly

**Ideal baseline knowledge:**

* Ledger & close: general ledger, journal entries, trial balance, period close
* Valuation & fees: NAV, valuations and marks, accruals, fee calculations
* Controls & audit: reconciliations, audit trails, maker-checker approvals

**Technical Requirements**

**Application Design**

* Python and Java. Built production services in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL) and Java (Spring Boot, Maven). Comparable languages and frameworks are acceptable.
* Spec-driven development. Drove a spec-driven approach end to end through a product development lifecycle. The written spec led requirements, design, implementation, and verification, and it changed before the build did.
* Enterprise-grade web application development. Architected and owned a robust production web service: authentication/authorization, business logic, data models, data contracts, and application service boundaries.
* API and domain modeling. Designed contracts a UI and an agent can both consume: versioning, errors, idempotency, and role-based permissions.
* Correctness with numbers and dates. Handled currency, precision, rounding, negative values, periods, and timezones in production.
* Snowflake and database architecture. Owned the schema design and implementation for a large-data system.
* Infrastructure as code. Shipped IaC based application.
* Testing as a habit. Wrote unit and integration tests with mocked network calls, not “QA will catch it.”

**Strong pluses:**
Experience with the Azure stack.

**AI Agent Design**

* AI agent building. Built and owned a production agent end to end: an LLM with a deliberate model choice, a multi-step workflow, the tools it calls, context carried from step to step, and results stored in a database.
* Structured outputs. Returned a schema the caller can validate.
* Evals. Built a robust eval framework for a production agent.
* Human-in-the-loop. Put a stop in code before a journal entry or a submitted close.
* Deterministic numbers. Kept calculations in services. The agent retrieves, compares, and raises exceptions.
* Strong pluses: implementation of an MCP server into production, accounting based agentic workflows.

description:
**Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Work Location Preference:**
Candidates based in Mumbai or nearby locations preferred
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**We are looking for engineers who have built and owned complex production systems - not simply contributed to them.**
**Industry:**
Financial Technology (FinTech), Fund Accounting, Financial Services, AI-Driven Enterprise Applications
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on
**Senior Backend Engineer**
with demonstrated experience designing, developing, and owning complex enterprise-grade backend applications. The ideal candidate is a proven builder who has independently taken a substantial software service or application module from initial requirements through architecture, development, testing, deployment, and production support. You will contribute to an
**AI-assisted financial operations platform designed for fund controllers**
, supporting trial balances, reconciliation workflows, financial calculations, multi-level approvals, and accounting processes. This position requires strong backend engineering fundamentals, database architecture expertise, production AI agent development experience, and a commitment to financial data accuracy, consistency, and auditability.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Backend Engineering & Architecture
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, enterprise-grade backend applications.
* Own backend services throughout the complete software development lifecycle.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and architecture.
* Design robust REST APIs, application services, database schemas, and business logic.
* Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and secure data access.
* Build APIs supporting both traditional web applications and AI-driven agents.
* Ensure reliability, performance, data integrity, and production readiness.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide long-term technical solutions.

Financial Application Development
  
  

* Develop backend services supporting fund accounting and financial operations.
* Implement workflows involving trial balances, general ledgers, journal entries, and accounting period close.
* Support financial reconciliations, approvals, audit trails, and maker-checker controls.
* Design systems capable of handling currency precision, rounding, financial dates, and accounting periods.
* Ensure financial calculations are deterministic, reproducible, and auditable.
* Collaborate directly with finance, accounting, and business stakeholders.

AI Agent Development
  
  

* Design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI agents integrated with enterprise applications.
* Build LLM-powered workflows involving multiple steps, tools, and contextual information.
* Implement structured outputs with schema validation.
* Develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI agent accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Integrate human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms for sensitive financial actions.
* Ensure AI agents retrieve information, identify exceptions, and support decision-making while deterministic backend services perform financial calculations.
* Persist agent workflow state, execution results, and relevant audit information in databases.

Database, Infrastructure & Quality Engineering
  
  

* Design and implement scalable database architectures and optimized schemas.
* Work with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and other enterprise data platforms.
* Implement infrastructure-as-code for consistent application deployments.
* Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests.
* Mock external services and network calls during automated testing.
* Maintain production quality through code reviews, performance optimization, and systematic debugging.

**Required Technical Skills**
Technology / Capability
  
  
**Requirements**
Backend Programming
  
  
Python and Java; comparable enterprise backend technologies considered
  
  
Python Frameworks
  
  
FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy
  
  
Java Frameworks
  
  
Spring Boot, Maven
  
  
Databases
  
  
PostgreSQL, Snowflake, database schema design
  
  
API Development
  
  
REST APIs, API contracts, versioning, idempotency, error handling
  
  
Application Architecture
  
  
Enterprise web services, domain modeling, service boundaries
  
  
Security
  
  
Authentication, authorization, role-based permissions
  
  
Financial Data Handling
  
  
Currency precision, decimal calculations, rounding, periods, time zones
  
  
Development Methodology
  
  
Specification-driven software development
  
  
Cloud & Infrastructure
  
  
Infrastructure as Code; Azure experience preferred
  
  
Testing
  
  
Unit testing, integration testing, mocking
  
  
AI Engineering
  
  
LLM agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, structured outputs
  
  
Agent Quality
  
  
Evaluation frameworks, human approvals, persistent workflow state
  
  
**Mandatory Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of professional backend software engineering experience.
* Proven experience independently architecting, building, and owning a complex production backend service or significant application module.
* Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, API design, database modeling, and transactional integrity.
* Production backend development experience using Python, Java, or comparable technologies.
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing database architectures.
* Experience using written specifications to drive requirements, implementation, and verification.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver production-quality, thoroughly tested applications.
* Hands-on ownership of at least one production AI agent workflow, including LLM integration, tool calls, structured outputs, evaluations, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently with business stakeholders and translate ambiguous requirements into working solutions.

**Important:**
Specific programming languages and frameworks are flexible for exceptional backend engineers who demonstrate genuine end-to-end ownership. Production AI agent development and substantial backend service ownership remain essential.
  
  
**Preferred Domain Experience**
Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will receive priority consideration:
  
  

* Private Equity, Private Credit, Hedge Funds, and Alternative Asset Management
* Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, and Portfolio Accounting
* Corporate Accounting, ERP, General Ledger, and Financial Close Management
* Banking, Capital Markets, BFSI, and Financial Technology

**Preferred Financial Knowledge**

* General Ledger (GL), Journal Entries, and Trial Balance
* Net Asset Value (NAV), Valuations, and Financial Marks
* Accruals, Fee Calculations, and Period-End Close
* Financial Reconciliation and Exception Management
* Audit Trails, Financial Controls, and Maker-Checker Approval Workflows

**Additional Preferred Skills**

* Microsoft Azure cloud platform.
* Production implementation of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
* Agentic AI solutions developed for accounting or financial workflows.
* Experience with high-volume, data-intensive financial applications.
* Experience designing systems with strict requirements for financial data correctness and auditability.

What Makes an Ideal Candidate?
  
  
**We Are Particularly Interested In Engineers Who Can Demonstrate**
**End-to-end ownership:**
Independently built and maintained a substantial production service.
  
  
**Architectural judgment:**
Can explain design decisions, alternatives, and technical tradeoffs.
  
  
**Production accountability:**
Has handled real-world incidents, data issues, and performance challenges.
  
  
**Business understanding:**
Can collaborate directly with finance and accounting stakeholders.
  
  
**Engineering discipline:**
Prioritizes correctness, reliability, automated testing, and maintainability.
  
  
**Practical AI expertise:**
Has built real production AI workflows rather than only experimenting with LLM APIs.
  
  
**Ownership mindset:**
Can turn an ambiguous business problem into a deployed and supported technical solution.
  
  
Candidate Screening Questions
  
  
**Candidates Should Be Prepared To Discuss**

* Describe a complex backend service you personally designed and built from scratch. What were the major architectural decisions?
* Have you implemented backend services in Python, Java, or comparable technologies? Which frameworks and databases did you use?
* Have you worked on financial applications involving general ledgers, trial balances, reconciliations, or financial transactions?

* Have you designed Snowflake or PostgreSQL database architectures for large-scale applications?
* What is your experience with Infrastructure as Code and cloud deployments, particularly Azure?
* Can you describe a serious production issue you resolved in a system you owned?

description:

**BCM**
**Consulting – Banking & Capital Markets – API Integration**

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced API Integration professional for Digital Banking and Banking Transformation initiatives. The role requires strong techno-functional expertise in banking APIs, integration platforms, middleware technologies, Open Banking frameworks and Core Banking Systems. The successful candidate will design, implement, test and support enterprise-wide API integration solutions connecting Core Banking, Digital Channels, Payment Systems, Fintech Ecosystems and third-party applications.
  
  
**Role: API Integration – Digital Banking Experience: 4 to 8 Years**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as a Techno-Functional Consultant in Digital Banking and API Transformation projects.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable API and integration solutions.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, product owners and development teams to define integration strategies.
* Design and document API specifications, service contracts, integration workflows and business process flows.
* Work closely with Core Banking, Digital Banking, Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, CRM, Payment Systems and external ecosystem integrations.
* Participate in API lifecycle management, including design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring and support.
* Identify integration opportunities and recommend best-fit architecture patterns.
* Support Open Banking initiatives in line with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct client workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, solution walkthroughs and business demonstrations.
* Drive API integration testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT) and production deployment activities.
* Troubleshoot integration and production issues and coordinate with cross-functional teams for resolution.
* Review technical designs, integration specifications and operational readiness documentation.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, governance, compliance and performance standards.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* Strong experience in API design, development and integration.
* Experience with REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, GraphQL and event-driven integrations.
* Experience with API Gateway solutions, API management lifecycle and developer portal management.
* Experience with API security frameworks and knowledge of Open Banking standards and frameworks.
* Experience with integration platforms, enterprise service bus (ESB) solutions and messaging systems.
* Understanding of microservices architecture, containerization, Kubernetes, Docker and service mesh.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
* Understanding of CI/CD implementation and DevOps practices.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with one or more technologies such as Java, Spring Boot and Node.js.
* Experience using Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Jira and Confluence.

**Functional And Consulting Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Banking Operations and the Digital Banking ecosystem.
* Ability to understand and document business requirements and conduct requirement analysis, gap analysis and impact assessment.
* Ability to define epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience in business process mapping and process reengineering.
* Knowledge of customer onboarding, account servicing, payments, lending and the transaction lifecycle.
* Experience in Open Banking and Fintech integrations, with an understanding of API monetization and Banking-as-a-Service models.
* Ability to review integration test scenarios and ensure functional coverage.
* Experience conducting product demonstrations and stakeholder workshops.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, client-facing and consulting capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively in Agile and Scrum environments and coordinate across multiple vendor and stakeholder teams.

**Banking Domain Experience**
**Experience in one or more of the following areas:**

* Retail Banking; Corporate Banking; Digital Banking; Open Banking
* Lending and Loan Origination; Payments and Cards; Treasury Operations; Trade Finance
* Account Services; Customer Onboarding and KYC; Collections and Cash Management
* Wealth Management; Regulatory Reporting and Compliance
* API Banking and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS)

**Ideally, You’ll Also**
Be a techno-functional integration professional who combines banking-domain knowledge, API delivery experience and consulting capability to connect business requirements with secure, scalable and supportable integration solutions.
  
  
**What We Look For**

* 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in API integration, Digital Banking or Banking Transformation initiatives.
* Hands-on experience across the API lifecycle, from design and documentation through testing, deployment, monitoring and support.
* Ability to work across Core Banking, digital channels, payment systems, Fintech ecosystems and third-party applications.

**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes.

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

**Why This Role Matters**

You own the platform every part of ParamAIQ is built on. The app, the AI features, the integrations for law firms: all of it runs through the API and services layer you build. When a lawyer trusts us with a confidential matter and expects it to be fast, correct, and private, your systems are what make that true.

This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You make the architectural calls, and you write the code that matters most. In legal software a bug is not cosmetic: it is a confidential matter exposed or a filing that fails, so we want senior people who get the foundations right the first time.

**What You'll Own**

* The product API and services layer: The architecture and the code.
* AI feature systems: Long-running, sometimes-failing operations that still feel fast and reliable to a lawyer under deadline.
* Multi-tenant isolation: Strong enough that one firm's matters are provably invisible to another. In legal, a cross-tenant leak is the worst thing that can happen.
* Data models for legal work: Matters, drafts, versions, and audit trails that stay coherent as the product grows.
* Reliability, performance, and cost: As the system scales.
* The rest of the product surface: Authentication, billing, uploads, exports, and notifications.

**The Hard Problems You'll Take On**

* Making unreliable, slow AI operations feel dependable: Model calls fail, time out, and cost money. The orchestration, idempotency, and graceful degradation that hide this from a lawyer is a real systems problem.
* Isolation you can prove: Not just separating tenants, but demonstrating and testing that separation across every path in the product.
* Getting the foundations right early: The data models, contracts, and access control you set now are the hardest to change later, and the most expensive to get wrong once real client data is flowing.

**What You Bring**

* 4+ years of backend engineering in Python, with a framework like FastAPI, Django, or Flask
* You design systems, not just features: you reason about scale, reliability, cost, and failure, and you defend your calls
* You've built multi-tenant SaaS with real data isolation between customers
* Strong API and service design: contracts, versioning, idempotency, rate limiting, backpressure
* Solid PostgreSQL: schema, indexing, transactions, performance
* Real command of auth: OAuth, OIDC, JWT, sessions, RBAC
* You write careful code and test the paths that matter, because you know what a mistake costs here
* Ready to work from our Mumbai office, full-time

**Bonus Points**

* 0-to-1 and early scale: you've taken a system from first version to real load and know what breaks first
* Performance and reliability work: profiling, load testing, and finding the failure before it reaches a user
* Async and background job systems (Celery, RQ) at scale
* Payments and billing systems (Razorpay, Stripe, or similar) and their failure modes
* Legal-tech, regtech, fintech, healthtech, or another regulated, trust-sensitive domain
* DPDPA, Indian data residency, and security practice

**What You Get**

* Real ownership of the platform and the architectural calls behind it, from day one
* The chance to get the foundations right on a product handling confidential legal matters
* Work shoulder to shoulder with practising lawyers on a product built for real legal work
* A hand in making justice more accessible in one of the largest judicial systems on earth

title: Connectors Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)
description:
**Role Title:**
Connectors Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)

**Department:**
Product Engineering

**Location:**
Mumbai / Pune (Onsite)

**Reports To:**
Engineering Manager

**Experience:**
5+ years, hiring across levels. Level is set by what you can own end to end, not by years on a resume.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Scitara:**
Scitara is a global leader in digital transformation for scientific laboratories, enabling connectivity, automation, and data integrity across instruments, applications, and enterprise systems. Our cloud-based DLX platform is used by the world's top pharma, biotech, life sciences, and industrial R&D labs to modernize workflows and accelerate scientific outcomes. Lab informatics is growing 50 to 70% over the next five years, at the exact moment AI is being layered onto scientific data workflows. None of that works until the data gets off the instrument. That is what connectors do.

**Role Summary:**
Connectors are how DLX reaches into the lab: chromatography systems, balances, plate readers, LIMS, ELNs, and vendor applications that were never designed to talk to anything. They are C#/.NET Windows services running on lab PCs, with no web stack. Each one is its own small project with its own surprises: a vendor SDK, a COM or OLE interface, a serial protocol, a file drop, a database nobody documented. Because there are dozens of these projects and each one is different, this role is for a generalist who is comfortable being handed an unfamiliar system and working out how to make it reliable. A specialty in one integration style is welcome on top of that, but it will be useful on one project in fifty, so it cannot be the whole story.

**How Engineering Works Here:**

We are a small team with a large product. That shapes everything:

**You deliver features, not tickets**
. You get a target system and a goal. You work out how to talk to it, what the data looks like, how to make it reliable, and how to prove it. Nobody hands you a task list.

**AI is part of the job.**
We use agentic coding tools every day to design, generate, test, and document. You are expected to work this way and to be a sharp reviewer of what the tools produce. You own the result, not the tool.

**We are regulated.**
Connectors run inside validated GxP labs. Data integrity, traceability, and auditability are design constraints, not a checklist at the end.

**Thinkers and doers.**
The people who do well here notice problems, propose fixes, get them wrong sometimes, and get them right the next time. They bring ideas back to the team instead of waiting to be told.

**Key Outcomes (First 6 to 12 Months):**
Deliver complete connectors into customer labs: discovery, design, implementation, tests, validation evidence, documentation. Take a target system from "here is the vendor" to a working plan without waiting for a task breakdown. Improve the shared connector framework and tooling so the next connector is faster than the last. Use AI tooling to cut the time from vendor documentation (or its absence) to working code. Senior / Lead: own the connector architecture and set the bar for the engineers around you.

**Responsibilities:**
Responsibilities Design and build connectors as C#/.NET Windows services that integrate instruments and lab systems with the DLX platform. Work with whatever the target exposes: REST, vendor SDKs, COM/OLE, file systems, databases, serial and network protocols. Build for environments you do not control: locked-down lab PCs, restricted networks, machines you cannot restart at will. Write code that meets data integrity and validation requirements. Use agentic development tools as the default way of working, and review their output critically. Troubleshoot integration issues in customer environments using structured problem-solving. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies as a contributor, not an attendee. Senior / Lead: lead spikes on new integration approaches; mentor and raise engineering standards.

**Must-Have:**
Strong C# and .NET, including long-running services (Windows Services or equivalent), not just web applications. You have integrated with systems you did not build and could not change, and made those integrations reliable. Comfortable starting from incomplete or missing documentation and working out how a system behaves. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong. A track record of delivering work you were given as goals, not as task lists. Solid engineering fundamentals: design, testing, debugging. Git and CI/CD in a team setting.

**Good-to-Have:**
COM/OLE, Windows API, instrument protocols (serial, GPIB, TCP/IP), or file-based integrations. Lab informatics or scientific instruments: LIMS, ELN, CDS, chromatography, analytical instruments. Regulated software: GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity. Messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and distributed or event-driven design. Exposure to the platform side: Node.js/TypeScript, cloud services, AWS. Building AI agents or working with MCP servers.

**Success Indicators:**
Connectors reach customer labs without needing the plan written for you. Each connector you deliver makes the next one easier. Your use of AI tooling makes you faster and your work more thorough, and your peers pick up what you learn. Colleagues in product, quality, services, and the platform team trust your judgement. Senior / Lead: connector decisions get made well when the architect is not in the room.

**Why Join Scitara?**
Get real instruments talking to real science for the labs developing the next generation of therapies. Variety: every connector is a new system and a new problem. Work in an engineering culture where AI-native development is the default, not an experiment. Real ownership: designs and decisions are yours. Clear paths into technical leadership and architecture.
