title: Principal Engineer - Trading Platform
description:
**Job Summary**
Our trading platform is the engine the fund runs on. We're looking for the engineer who will own it — the architecture, the code, and the team that builds it.
  
  
You will set the technical direction and make the hard architectural calls, and you will stay deep in the code, building the most critical and latency-sensitive parts yourself. You will lead a strong engineering team, and you will be accountable for everything the platform does in live markets: that it's fast from tick to trade, that it's correct, that it stays up while markets are open, and that it behaves safely with real capital.
  
  
This is a builder's leadership role. You own the outcomes across the whole platform — including its connectivity, colocation, resilience, security, and regulatory posture — and you will shape the infrastructure and the exchange, broker, and vendor relationships beneath it. What this is not is an IT-administration job: as we grow, dedicated infrastructure and operations support will carry the hands-on run-work so you stay focused on building and leading.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* The architecture and technical direction of the platform end to end — market data, signal, execution, and risk — and the calls that shape how it's built.
* The hardest code. You design and build the critical, latency-sensitive components yourself, and set the engineering standard the team builds to.
* The tick-to-trade path: finding and winning back latency across ingestion, decision, and order placement, and keeping it predictable under load.
* Risk and safety in the system — the pre-trade and at-trade controls that keep the platform from doing damage with real money. These are the controls that have to hold even when everything else is failing.
* Own the testing and staged-rollout discipline that makes changes safe to ship.
* The team — hiring, mentoring senior engineers, owning delivery, and raising the bar.
* Reliability in live markets: uptime through the session, fault tolerance that fails safe, monitoring of both the systems and what they produce (fills, PnL, slippage), incident response during market hours, and the hardening that follows.
* The platform's connection to the outside world — exchange and market-data feeds, the OMS, brokers — and accountability for the leased lines, colocation, physical infrastructure, redundancy, and failover beneath it, including getting new venues (NSE, BSE, MCX) certified and connected and coordinating the exchanges, brokers, and vendors behind them.
* Resilience and continuity — backup connectivity, disaster recovery, and business-continuity planning, tested with real drills.
* Security and governance — setting the security and governance policies, building access control, secrets, and auditability in, and keeping the platform ready for SEBI and exchange scrutiny.
* Scale — growing the platform with data, accounts, strategies, new markets, and AUM, and partnering with research and operations to turn what they need into systems that hold up.

**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**

* You know the platform cold, and the team ships through you without you being the bottleneck.
* Tick-to-trade latency and uptime are measured, understood, and trending the right way.
* The risk controls are something you'd trust with the firm's capital — because you've tested them.
* A new venue or market has gone live cleanly, or the path to it is genuinely de-risked.
* The platform's security and DR posture would survive a SEBI or exchange inspection without a scramble.

**Who You Are**

* A senior engineer who leads from the front — you want to own both the architecture and a team, and you're better at each because you do both.
* Someone who can personally solve the hardest problems in a real-time system, not route them to someone else.
* An owner by temperament — of decisions, of uptime during market hours when something breaks, and of the consequences.
* Calm under the particular pressure of live markets, where mistakes cost money and the clock doesn't stop.
* A clear communicator who can work across research, operations, and compliance, and hold their own with exchanges, brokers, and vendors.

**Required**

* 10+ years building and operating production backend systems, with real time spent leading engineers or owning a platform's technical direction.
* Expert Python and deep command of asyncio and concurrency — event loops, backpressure, race conditions — on an async-end-to-end platform (FastAPI/Starlette, heavy asyncio).
* A real track record with real-time, event-driven systems: live market-data and order-event streams over WebSockets, coordinated through a pub/sub backbone.
* Experience integrating with external trading infrastructure — exchange and market-data feeds, an OMS, and brokers — over socket and HTTP APIs, with the discipline order placement and state tracking demand.
* Strong judgement across a mixed data layer: an operational store such as MongoDB, Redis (with Sentinel for high availability), and a time-series or columnar store such as ClickHouse.
* Proven ability to design always-on services for reliability and observability, and to own uptime in production.
* Comfort owning a containerised, multi-service setup end to end — Docker, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
* Enough grounding in the Indian market-structure and regulatory context — exchange connectivity and colocation, OMSs such as XTS, Greeksoft, or ODIN, venues such as NSE, BSE, and MCX, and SEBI's IT, cyber, DR, and BCP expectations — to own these outcomes and work credibly with exchanges, brokers, and vendors.
* A record of making sound architectural decisions and leading a team to deliver against them.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building high-frequency or ultra-low-latency trading systems, where the hot path is measured in microseconds.
* Hands-on with kernel-bypass networking (Solarflare/Onload, DPDK), FPGA, or other hardware acceleration for market data and order entry.
* Experience with tick-by-tick (TBT) feeds and the colocation setups that make microsecond latency achievable.
* Low-level performance engineering: lock-free data structures, cache-aware and zero-allocation hot paths, and C/C++/Rust where Python can't go.

**Why Northstar**

* Full ownership of the platform the fund runs on, and the mandate to shape where it goes — new venues and markets, an in-house OMS and data-feed adapter, and the move toward lower-latency trading.
* A serious team and direct access to the people running the fund — short path from decision to shipped.
* Meaningful ownership in what you build.
* Health insurance for spouse and kids, a good working environment, and an annual company retreat.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Cloud & AI Infrastructure
description:
**Job Title**
: Forward Deployed Engineer – Cloud & AI Infrastructure

**Company**
: Host360

**Location**
: Onsite (Mumbai - Andheri East)

**Employment Type**
: Full Time

**Experience**
: 2–4 Years

**Function**
: Platform Engineering | AI Infrastructure

**Focus**
: Cloud Infrastructure | AI Platform Deployment | Software Engineering | Customer Engineering

**CTC**
– As per Industry Standards

**About Host360**

At Host360, we are building a next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure platform that enables enterprises to modernize their infrastructure, deploy AI workloads, and run mission-critical applications at scale.

Our offerings span public cloud, private cloud, GPU infrastructure, AI platforms, Kubernetes, bare-metal infrastructure, and managed cloud services. We help organizations build secure, scalable, and high-performance environments for modern applications and AI-driven workloads.

We are looking for a
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)**
who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and AI. You will work directly with customers to understand complex technical challenges, design and implement solutions, and take them from initial discovery to reliable production deployments.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real-world problems, building systems that work in production, and turning customer requirements into reusable engineering solutions.

**The Role**

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Host360, you will work closely with customer engineering teams to deploy AI workloads, modernize infrastructure, and build production-ready cloud-native solutions.

You will operate across software, infrastructure, and AI platforms, combining deep technical execution with customer collaboration. You will be expected to move beyond architecture discussions and prototypes to build, deploy, troubleshoot, and optimize working systems in real enterprise environments.

You will own outcomes such as deployment speed, system reliability, performance, resource utilization, and customer adoption. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working across multiple layers of the technology stack and can independently take a problem from ambiguity to a working production solution.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Customer Engineering & Solution Development**

* Work directly with customer engineering and platform teams to understand technical requirements, infrastructure challenges, and business objectives.
* Translate ambiguous problems into clear technical solutions, implementation plans, and measurable success criteria.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture discussions, proof-of-concepts, and hands-on implementation workshops.
* Build and deploy solutions within customer environments, adapting to their existing infrastructure, applications, and operational constraints.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and take ownership until the solution is stable and operational.

**2. Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering**

* Design, deploy, and optimize cloud infrastructure across public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud, and bare-metal environments.
* Implement infrastructure solutions involving compute, storage, networking, security, and virtualization.
* Work with containerized applications, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.
* Build and maintain infrastructure automation using Python, Bash, Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Support application migration, infrastructure modernization, workload optimization, and platform integration.
* Diagnose infrastructure bottlenecks involving networking, storage, compute, resource allocation, and application performance.

**3. AI Infrastructure & Platform Deployment**

* Help customers deploy and operationalize AI and Generative AI workloads on cloud and GPU infrastructure.
* Set up environments for LLM inference, model serving, AI applications, and agent-based workflows.
* Work with GPU-enabled infrastructure, containerized AI workloads, model runtimes, and inference-serving frameworks.
* Integrate AI applications with APIs, databases, storage systems, and enterprise platforms.
* Assist in building reliable AI deployment pipelines with appropriate monitoring, resource management, and scaling mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot AI workload issues involving GPU utilization, memory consumption, latency, throughput, model serving, and infrastructure performance.

**4. Software Engineering & Automation**

* Build production-grade tools, scripts, APIs, integrations, and automation workflows that solve customer engineering problems.
* Use Python and, where appropriate, Go, TypeScript, or JavaScript to develop practical engineering solutions.
* Develop integrations across cloud platforms, infrastructure management systems, observability tools, and AI services.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks, deployment workflows, infrastructure provisioning, and troubleshooting processes.
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools to accelerate engineering workflows.
* Build reusable components, deployment templates, and automation frameworks that can be applied across multiple customer environments.

**5. Production Reliability & Optimization**

* Take ownership of deployed solutions beyond the initial implementation, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and continuous improvement.
* Implement monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting to maintain production reliability.
* Investigate incidents, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Evaluate performance, scalability, security, resource utilization, and cost efficiency.
* Establish safe deployment practices, rollback mechanisms, and operational runbooks.
* Measure the impact of deployed solutions through meaningful technical and business outcomes.

**6. Product Feedback & Reusable Engineering**

* Collaborate with Host360’s Platform Engineering, Product, and AI Infrastructure teams to address challenges encountered during customer deployments.
* Convert recurring customer requirements into reusable tools, platform capabilities, and product improvements.
* Document architecture decisions, deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, and implementation patterns.
* Develop reusable reference architectures, automation scripts, and technical playbooks.
* Share real-world feedback to improve Host360’s cloud platform, AI infrastructure, and developer experience.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong engineering mindset with the ability to independently investigate problems, design solutions, write code, and deliver working systems.
* 2-4 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role.
* Strong programming experience in Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, or another relevant language, with the ability to build practical engineering tools and integrations.
* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, or operating cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, private cloud, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience working with Linux systems, networking fundamentals, APIs, distributed systems, and production troubleshooting.
* Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, containerized applications, or cloud-native deployment environments.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, or Infrastructure as Code.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical architectures and working implementations.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application, infrastructure, and platform layers.
* Ability to take ownership of a problem from discovery and implementation through deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with customer engineers and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting AI, Generative AI, LLM, or machine learning workloads in production.
* Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA fundamentals, GPU scheduling, or GPU resource utilization.
* Experience with model serving and inference frameworks such as vLLM, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with open-source AI models, model runtimes, inference optimization, and AI application frameworks.
* Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Helm, GitOps, or Kubernetes operators.
* Exposure to private cloud and virtualization technologies such as OpenStack, VMware, Nutanix, or Proxmox.
* Experience with observability platforms, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or distributed tracing.
* Familiarity with databases, object storage, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to build, debug, test, and maintain production software.
* Previous experience in customer engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or embedded engineering roles.

**What We’re Looking For**

We value demonstrated engineering ability, practical problem-solving, and ownership over a particular combination of degrees, certifications, or technology keywords.

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy getting hands-on with unfamiliar systems and figuring out how they work.
* Can move from an unclear customer problem to a working implementation without relying entirely on predefined instructions.
* Are comfortable switching between application code, cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, and AI workloads.
* Prefer building and debugging real systems over producing architecture documents alone.
* Can explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* Take responsibility for production outcomes rather than considering a deployment complete when the initial setup is finished.
* Enjoy learning new technologies and sharing what you learn with the wider engineering team.

**At Host360, we are looking for engineers who don’t just recommend solutions — they build them, deploy them, and make them work in production.**

description:
**Founding Engineer (Backend, TypeScript)**

AssureNode | Full time, permanent | Mumbai hybrid preferred; remote within India for the right candidate Reports to the founder | 4+ years of backend engineering with production ownership

**Build and own the technology**

AssureNode is building a continuous compliance and Governance, Risk and Compliance automation platform. It is designed to connect to cloud, code, identity and HR systems, collect evidence, and help organisations assess and demonstrate compliance with frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and requirements under India’s DPDP Act.

The platform is in development. We are looking for an in-house technical owner who can work with our engineering partner during development, independently assess the system, and lead our first design partner integration and transition into production.

**Your first 90 days**

Handover, testing and integration will overlap. Priorities will depend on your joining date, module readiness and the design partner’s needs.

• Learn and verify the system: review the architecture and decision records, run it end to end, understand the development workflow, and establish company-controlled access to repositories, environments and deployment tooling.

• Test as modules arrive: build and run a readiness plan covering tenant isolation, authentication, permissions, audit trails, evidence handling, exports and recovery. Track defects and work with the engineering partner to resolve them.

• Lead integration and readiness: validate the integrations needed by the first design partner, rehearse releases and rollback, and recommend whether the platform is ready to launch. Agree the launch decision with the founder and technical reviewers.

**What you will own**

• Backend development across compliance workflows, evidence collection, integrations, monitoring and policies.

• Security and quality: customer data boundaries, access controls, database changes, code review and release checks. Support AssureNode’s SOC 2 and ISO 27001 work through change records, access reviews and customer security questionnaires.

• Reliable integrations that handle failures, retries, rate limits and changing third-party APIs.

• Production operations: deployment, monitoring, incident response, runbooks and recovery testing, with support responsibilities agreed during handover.

• Technical decisions, clear communication with the founder and clients, and helping hire the next engineers.

**How we work**

You will help maintain a disciplined development workflow: written architecture decisions, automated checks and review before changes merge. The role requires challenging assumptions, reading code critically and testing security properties. Automated checks support engineering judgement; they do not replace independent review.

**What we are looking for**

4+ years building backend services, including at least 2 years of TypeScript or Node.js in production, and experience as the senior or sole engineer responsible for a live product.

• Strong PostgreSQL fundamentals: data modelling, migrations, indexing, transactions and query performance.

• Experience with NestJS or a comparable Node.js framework, and practical AWS and CI/CD knowledge.

• Sound security habits across authentication, authorisation, secrets management and application security testing.

• The ability to find problems in code you did not write, prioritise risk and explain trade-offs to non-engineers.

Useful experience includes multi-tenant SaaS and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, Drizzle ORM, WorkOS, background workers, the outbox pattern, infrastructure as code, and B2B security or compliance products. You do not need every tool on this list.

**Our stack**

TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS and Fastify; PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security and Drizzle ORM; WorkOS; AWS; Next.js; GitHub and GitHub Actions.

**Ownership and growth**

You will work directly with the founder and have substantial responsibility for the platform and engineering standards. The role can grow into Head of Engineering and potentially CTO as the company grows, depending on performance, demonstrated leadership and business needs.

Mumbai hybrid preferred; remote within India for the right candidate. Earliest start: 1 December 2026. Please share your availability.

**Working with the founder**

The founder leads business and product. Founder is the ex-Head of Fintech Solutions at NPCI who drove the UPI and RuPay businesses in India. You will own the technology, work closely together on product decisions and build an engineering team over time. We will discuss workload expectations and support openly.

**Hiring process**

A founder conversation covering the role, availability and compensation; a two-hour take-home code review exercise; a technical and architecture discussion; and a working conversation on ownership and collaboration. References and any agreed checks follow before an offer. We will confirm the technical reviewers and exercise instructions in advance.

title: Contact Center Technology Engineer
description:
Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.**
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
This position is responsible for managing a variety of tasks supporting the overall contact center technology ecosystem including phone & messaging platforms, IVR, and reporting. This individual must monitor system uptime, conduct periodic testing, investigate technology issues, plan, design, track, and modify IVR-enabled telecommunications systems using Amazon Connect or similar technologies.
  
  
**In This Role You Will Get To**

* Technical Acumen – Manage various contact center configurations including: IVR & ACD (Amazon Connect/AWS DynamoDb, Lambda,S3, Cloudwatch/logs), Contact Control Panel (CCP), API integrations, QA, QM, WFM platforms (Verint or equivalent), troubleshooting IVR issues, etc.
* Fortify & Optimize – Support remote contact center teams globally that depend on stable technology platforms to facilitate customer interactions and agent transaction processing. Seek opportunities to secure/harden the contact center infrastructure and improve the proactive monitoring of critical components. Ensure the quality of contact center service in terms of stability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
* Vendor Engagement – Facilitate discussions with outsource partners and contact center technology vendors (Verint, Amazon and other leading contact center tools ) to achieve business objectives.
* Analytics – Analyze metrics on platform/system performance to ensure uptime requirements are met. Continually review and make recommendations to the business on ways technology can be leveraged to improve the customer experience and/or maximize operational efficiency.
* Incident Management - Assist with efforts related to service restoration and root cause analysis. Work through outsource partner counterparts to remedy service degradations and develop proper preventive measures as needed to prevent future service failures. Manage day to day technology issues/concerns at our contact centers globally.

**Who You Are**

* 3+ years in technology or a related field.
* Direct experience with AWS and Amazon Connect/AWS DynamoDb, Lambda,S3, Cloudwatch/logs) is a plus
* Exposure with enterprise-scale IVR
* A basic understanding of programming languages and machine learning concepts preferred.
* Familiarity with voice and data networking.
* Prior call center operations experience is preferred.
* Previous experience in the travel / hospitality industry is considered an asset.
* Effectively communicate with individuals at all levels internally and externally.
* Solid analytical, follow-up, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to operate successfully in a time-sensitive and fast-paced contact center environment,
* Access Management, Troubleshooting and remediation of tech issues reported at our contact centers.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

**Who We Are**
WE ARE PRICELINE.
  
  
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion are a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, it’s important we have a workforce that reflects the diverse customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love you to join us and add to our rich mix!
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

description:

🌱 We were founded in 2007

**740**
previous companies, from startups to global giants

**FinTech’s Finest 50**
by Welcome to the Jungle
  
  
💪 We’re proud to be an accredited
**Real Living Wage**
employer, ensuring everyone is paid fairly for the great work they do!
  
  
**Our Product & Engineering Team:**
Liberis is building the embedded finance platform that lets partners around the world offer innovative funding products to their small business customers. We're a growth-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data & Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.
  
  
Engineering is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.
  
  
Our Salesforce Team:
  
  
You’ll join the Salesforce engineering team within Liberis’ wider Technology function. The team owns and evolves the Salesforce platform that underpins how Liberis acquires, onboards, and supports merchants and partners across 15 markets. They also work closely with other engineering development teams, product teams, and business functions such as commercial and operations to turn business needs into reliable, well-built Salesforce solutions.
  
  
The role:
  
  
As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you’ll take ownership of complex Salesforce solutions from discovery through to production. You’ll work across both code and configuration, making informed technical decisions around architecture, automation, integrations, security, and maintainability.
  
  
You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.
  
  
You’ll remain hands-on with Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and declarative tooling, while also acting as a technical point of reference for other members of the team. You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.
  
  
Success in the role means consistently delivering high-quality solutions with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and having a positive impact on both the platform and the engineers around you.
  
  
What you’ll get to do:
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and declarative tools such as Flow, validation rules, and Salesforce configuration.
* Own complex features and technical changes end to end, from understanding the business problem and shaping the technical approach through to testing, release, and production support.
* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Write high-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, investigate root causes, and help improve platform resilience and observability.
* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.

What we think you’ll need:
  
  

* Proven success in a hands-on Salesforce development role, with experience delivering and owning complex Salesforce solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A collaborative approach and experience supporting, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other developers.
* Good judgement around when to use code versus declarative Salesforce functionality, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and platform health.

**Next steps**
If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com
  
  
Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. You can have a look through our Engineering Career Framework via this link
  
  
**Our hybrid approach**
Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. **About You And This Role**
DOW has an exciting and challenging opportunity for an
**Azure Data Platform Engineer**
**on the Enterprise Data & Analytics Data Platform**
team.

The role will align to Dow's Design your Day approach and allows employees to work remotely but will also require onsite work based on project work and role needs. * Interested about emerging technologies with the ability to quickly learn and exploit cutting edge offerings to achieve business objectives.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* A minimum of a bachelor's degree in IT discipline or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
* Recent experience designing and deploying in Microsoft Azure’s Environment.

* Coding & Scripting: PowerShell (Python and SQL basics)
* Cloud: Azure
* Azure Services: Databricks, Databricks Workspace, V-Net, Networking, Azure SQL Server, Function Apps, Storage Accounts, API Management

Good to have skills -

title: Backend / Platform Lead
description:
**Backend / Platform Lead**

* **The opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo is the most recognised name in premium tattooing in India — a ₹45 Cr brand with a credible line of sight to ₹500 Cr by 2030, built across a premium studio network scaling to 100 locations, India's largest tattoo school, and a growing home-service business.

A business growing this fast runs on technology. We build our own products — for sales, customer relationships, communication, operations, people and learning — and we're bringing them together into one platform that the whole company runs on, every day.

We're looking for the engineer who builds that foundation.

* **The mandate**

You will own the backend and the platform end to end — architecture, data, cloud infrastructure, integrations, security and reliability. Every product we build will run on what you design, and the business will depend on it every hour of every day.

This is a function to be built, not inherited. You'll set the architecture and the engineering standards, decide what we build and what we buy, and hire and lead the engineers who build alongside you. You'll sit at the table when product decisions are made and have the authority to make the technical calls.

* **What you'll be doing**

Designing a platform that's simple today and still holds up at ten times the scale — shared services, clean APIs and one source of truth for the company's data.

Running production on cloud infrastructure built for failure, so a server, a zone or a bad release never takes the business down.

Building the pipeline every change goes through — automated tests, staging, gradual rollouts, fast rollback — and backups you've proven you can restore.

Owning the data layer — schemas, performance, data quality and migrations from older tools without losing a record.

Connecting to messaging, payments, telephony and partner services through queues and retries, so no event is ever lost.

Building real-time systems — live updates, notifications and communication features — and knowing when to build them and when to buy them.

Setting the engineering standard — code review, testing, security, and how the team safely uses AI tools.

Turning business needs into clear technical plans, with honest trade-offs on cost, risk and time.

Hiring and growing the team that does all of the above.

* **What we're looking for**

You've done this before — not studied it, done it. You've owned a production system real people depended on, been the one called when it broke, and fixed it under pressure. You know what breaks when a system grows tenfold, and you've designed for it before it happened.

You are deep on the backend. Relational databases, Node.js with TypeScript (or Python), queues, APIs and a major cloud platform — you don't just use them, you know how they fail.

You are pragmatic to the core. You pick proven tools over fashionable ones, and you can explain why to a non-technical leader — in plain language, with the cost and the risk.

You are hands-on and senior in equal measure. You can design the architecture on Monday and debug a failed release at 9pm on Thursday.

You build teams. You review code carefully, teach as you go, and hire people who raise the bar.

Experience with real-time systems, telephony or voice platforms, payments or offline-first applications is a serious plus.

* **What success looks like**

Ninety days in, core systems run on resilient cloud infrastructure, every product has monitoring and alerts, and we've proven we can restore from backup.

Six months in, our products share one identity and one source of customer data, releases ship every week without drama, and the engineering standards are written down and followed.

Here's the part most candidates get wrong, so we'll be direct. Plenty of engineers can build features. Far fewer can own a system — know it's about to fail before it does, roll back calmly when it does, and make sure it never fails the same way twice. This role needs the second kind. If your instinct when production breaks is to wait for someone else, this isn't your seat.

title: Agent Engineer - Evals and Harness
description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems. While that is the vision, the mission is to build safety aware autonomous systems in the extreme near term. Our research work spans areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris, and London.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Our current sprint on building autonomous systems for complex problems, across software engineering, data science, and AI research, involves building the harness, execution substrate and evaluation system, and each is designed to run inside a customer's environment rather than ours.

This role sits underneath all three agents. The coding agent, the data science agent and the AI engineering agent look different from the outside, but they are the same system underneath: a loop that plans, acts, observes, recovers, and knows when to stop. You will build that shared layer, and the evaluation system that tells us whether any change to it made things better. Both halves matter equally. A harness we cannot measure is a harness we cannot improve.

****What you'll work on:****

Harness

* The core agent loop and its execution model, covering orchestration, concurrency, sub-agent coordination, cancellation, timeouts, checkpointing and resume.
* Context and state management for long-running tasks, including retention, compaction, and how an agent reasons over what it has already done.
* The shared tool protocol, its schemas, versioning, and the internal libraries every agent team builds against.
* The execution substrate. Sandboxed environments that are reproducible, snapshot-able and resource-bounded, and that behave identically for a repository task, a training run and a data analysis.
* Failure semantics. Retry policy, partial failure, idempotency, and the distinction between a recoverable error and a task that should stop and hand back.
* The trace schema every agent emits, which serves at once as our debugging surface, our training signal, and the audit record our customers keep.
  
  

Evals

* Task suites for each agent type, built from real work rather than synthetic benchmarks, and the infrastructure to run them at scale in parallel.
* Verifiers and scoring. Deterministic checks where the task allows it, model-graded rubrics where it does not, and calibration of the graders themselves.
* Regression gates that run on every harness change, with cost and latency accounted alongside quality.
* The statistics to say a result is real. Seeds, variance, pass@k, confidence, and knowing how many runs are needed before anyone claims an improvement.
* Turning observed production failures into permanent test cases.
* Tooling for how we work. Trace inspection, replay, and diffing one run against another.
  
  

You will work across all three agent teams and closely with our research team on evaluation design, post-training and interpretability of agent behavior.

What We Are Looking For

This is a systems and infrastructure role. Most of the difficulty here is concurrency, state and measurement, not prompting.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and advanced Python. You have shipped and operated production services, not only written them.
* Concurrency and distributed systems. Async execution, worker pools and queues, retries and idempotency, backpressure, cancellation, and reasoning clearly about what happens when a step fails halfway through.
* Containers and sandboxing. Docker and OCI internals, resource isolation, reproducible environments, and an understanding of why a job that passes locally fails in a sandbox.
* Test and CI infrastructure. You have built test harnesses, run large suites in parallel, and dealt with flakiness as an engineering problem rather than an annoyance.
* Measurement literacy. Comfort with variance, sampling and significance, and healthy skepticism toward benchmark results including your own.
* Observability instincts. Distributed tracing, structured logging, and building the inspection tooling that makes non-deterministic systems debuggable.
* You debug systematically. You find out what actually happened rather than adjusting things until the symptom disappears.
* You are comfortable when problems are loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.
* Experience with evaluation or benchmarking work for AI systems is a strong plus.
* Experience with agentic systems, LLM inference and serving, or developer tooling is a plus.
* Open source contributions we can read are a plus.
  
  

We are hiring several engineers for this team at a range of experience levels, including engineers early in their careers who have strong fundamentals and want to work on agents from the infrastructure side.

We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

title: AI Agent Engineer Intern
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe AI systems for real-world deployment. Our work spans agentic AI, alignment, interpretability, evaluation systems, enterprise AI, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data.

We build AI systems where transparency, auditability, robustness, and controllability are first-class constraints. Our environment is fast-moving, research-driven, and highly hands-on. We value people who bring open ideas, take ownership, and turn ambiguity into meaningful outcomes.

The Role

We are looking for
****AI Agent Interns****

to work on high-impact agentic AI problems across applied, research, and product directions.

This is not a narrow internship focused on building small internal bots. You will work on real agentic systems, evaluation infrastructure, enterprise use cases, research prototypes, and product tooling that can shape how AI agents are built, tested, aligned, and deployed.

Depending on your interests and strengths, you may contribute across one or more of three tracks:

1. Applied Agentic AI

On the applied side, you will work on high-impact enterprise agentic use cases. This may involve building agents that reason over complex workflows, interact with tools and data systems, execute multi-step processes, evaluate outcomes, and operate reliably in real-world environments.

Example work may include enterprise workflow agents, agents over structured or proprietary data, human-in-the-loop agent systems, decision-support agents, and applied prototypes that can evolve into production-grade components.

Success in this track means building useful, reliable, and high-value agentic systems that solve real enterprise problems.

2. Agent R&D and Evaluation

On the R&D side, you will work on new ideas in agent architecture, harness design, evaluations, long-horizon reasoning, alignment, and interpretability.

This may include building new agent harnesses, designing evaluation frameworks, studying agent failure modes, benchmarking tool use and planning, or contributing to research papers, technical reports, and reusable research infrastructure.

Success in this track means producing research-quality insights, evaluation systems, benchmarks, or technical contributions that improve how agentic systems are understood and assessed.

3. Product and Tooling Agents

On the product and tooling side, you will help build agents that improve how researchers, engineers, and users interact with Lexsi systems.

This may include an
****AlignTune Agent****

for alignment workflows, AI Scientist-style agents for hypothesis generation and experiment execution, tools for evaluating and debugging agents, or product prototypes that turn research capabilities into usable workflows.

Success in this track means building tools that compound the productivity of researchers, engineers, or enterprise users.

Responsibilities

You will explore open-ended agentic AI problems and convert promising ideas into working prototypes, experiments, research artifacts, or product capabilities. You may build applied agents, design evaluations, create harnesses, experiment with planning and memory architectures, analyze failures, document findings, and collaborate with research, engineering, and product teams.

The expected outcome may be a production-grade applied component, a research contribution, a paper, a benchmark, an internal tool, or a product prototype.

Requirements

We are looking for candidates with strong programming skills, preferably in Python, hands-on experience with LLMs or AI systems, and a strong interest in agents, evaluation, alignment, interpretability, or enterprise AI.

You should be comfortable working on ambiguous problems, building prototypes quickly, reading papers or technical material, documenting findings clearly, and independently identifying high-value directions.

Bonus signals include experience with agent frameworks, long-horizon agents, evaluation pipelines, research projects, open-source tools, backend systems, enterprise data, or AI safety and interpretability.

Our Culture

We move quickly and value substance over polish. This internship is for people who want to work near the frontier of agentic AI, bring original ideas, build seriously, test honestly, and create work that matters.

title: Architect - Data Modeller
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Architect Data Modeler**
**Exp Range**
: 8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job Location**
: Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Data Modeler is responsible for the structural design of the platform's canonical and derived data assets. You will own the Common Data Model (CDM) at the schema level — the dimension, fact, bridge, and reference tables that hold normalized clinical, claims, and demographic data — and the source-to-target mappings (STTMs) that define how source-system data lands in CDM and how CDM data is reshaped into FHIR resources.
  
  
This role is hands-on. You will produce schema designs in collaboration with the architect, write STTM specifications that engineers implement against, and work with clinical informatics and source-system experts to ensure the model accurately reflects the data's clinical and operational meaning. Your output is the contract between source data and CDM, and between CDM and downstream consumers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the schema-level design of the Common Data Model — DIM (patient, person, encounter, provider, organization), FACT (observation, diagnosis, procedure, medication administration, claim line, encounter), BRIDGE (relationship-qualifier-aware), and REF (terminology and crosswalk) tables. Design columns, types, NULL semantics, hash key composition, SCD2 patterns, and partitioning strategies in coordination with the architect
* Develop and maintain Source-to-Target Mappings (STTMs) for every source-system feed — EPIC HL7v2 ADT/ORU/ORM, Cerner HL7v2, ambulatory EHR feeds, state HIE CCDA, payer claims CSVs, FHIR ingestion. STTMs specify field-by-field source-path → CDM-column mapping with explicit transformation, NULL handling, and validation rules
* Develop and maintain STTMs for FHIR serialization — for each in-scope US Core 6.1 resource (Patient, Encounter, Condition, Observation, Procedure, Practitioner, Organization, AllergyIntolerance), specify how every FHIR element derives from CDM columns, including cardinality, profile constraints, and terminology bindings
* Design data product schemas — the longitudinal patient mart, population analytics aggregations, risk adjustment marts, HEDIS measure pre-aggregations. Each data product has a defined grain, columns, and refresh semantics
* Author and maintain unit specs at the model level under the spec-driven development framework. Each table has a versioned spec; model changes go through the spec review process before implementation
* Collaborate with data engineers to translate model specs into dbt implementations. Review dbt model code for adherence to the spec, including column naming, hash key construction, SCD2 macro usage, and test coverage
* Participate in source-system data profiling — analyze sample data from each source to identify quality issues, edge cases, and modeling implications before specs are finalized. Profile findings drive STTM design
* Define and enforce reference data (REF) management practices — terminology crosswalks (LOINC, SNOMED, ICD-10, RxNorm, CPT), source-code-to-standard-code mappings, and the SCD2 patterns that govern reference data evolution
* Document data dictionaries, lineage, and the canonical model glossary. Engage with Atlan or equivalent governance tooling to publish model documentation for downstream consumers
* Work with clinical informaticists and source-system experts to validate that the model and STTMs accurately represent clinical reality. STTMs are the contract between engineering and clinical informatics; you own that contract

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field
* 5+ years of data modeling experience for large-scale data warehouses, data lakes, or data platforms
* Demonstrated ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models — dimensional modeling (Kimball), data vault, or hybrid patterns. This project uses a Kimball-influenced canonical model with SCD2 dimensions and per-source row preservation
* Strong SQL proficiency. Experience reading and reviewing dbt SQL models is required; ability to author dbt models is a plus
* Experience modeling for analytical and operational data layers simultaneously — understanding how a normalized canonical model serves both downstream analytics and FHIR API consumers
* Hands-on experience with healthcare data standards — HL7v2 segment-level structure, CCDA document structure, and FHIR R4 resource models. Familiarity with US Core profiles and FHIR Bundle composition
* Experience producing source-to-target mappings (STTMs) at field-level granularity for multi-source data integration projects
* Experience modeling SCD2 patterns and the operational implications of late-arriving data, restatement, and version closure
* Experience with terminology systems used in healthcare — LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, CPT, RxNorm — and their crosswalk patterns
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform data services (Cloud Storage, BigLake, Dataproc) and open table formats. Direct Iceberg experience is a plus
* Strong written communication skills. STTMs and model documentation are read across engineering, QA, clinical, and governance audiences

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Direct experience with the Optum Health Data Engine canonical model or comparable healthcare canonical models (OMOP, PCORnet CDM, Sentinel)
* Experience with master data management modeling — patient matching attributes, source-system identifier preservation, ECI lifecycle
* Experience with Atlan or comparable governance and lineage tooling
* Hands-on dbt authorship including macros, tests, and project structure
* Familiarity with FHIR Implementation Guides beyond US Core (CARIN BB, Da Vinci, IPA)
* Experience with data modeling tools (ER/Studio, Erwin, dbdiagram, SqlDBM) for diagram production

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

title: ML Research Scientist
description:
**ABOUT PARAMAIQ & NYAAYOS**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. India runs one of the largest judicial systems on earth: more than 55 million pending cases and one of the largest legal workforces anywhere. Yet legal expertise stays concentrated in a handful of senior counsel and metro firms. For a litigant in a district court, often arguing in a regional language, the outcome can turn on who they can afford. NyaayOS turns the primary sources of Indian law (the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, the BNSS and BSA, decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, statutes, and gazettes) into a reasoning layer any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes, so the bottleneck shifts from access back to advocacy. We give an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading

firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

Generating text is the easy part. The hard part is making sure every sentence we put in front of a lawyer rests on real, currently valid authority. That is the problem you own. You own how NyaayOS represents legal knowledge, and how it finds and verifies the law behind an answer. Indian law is vast, cross-referenced, and always moving statutes get amended, judgments get

overruled, positions shift. Turning that into something a machine can search, reason over, and stan behind is the core research problem of the company. You settle it with experiments against a legal eval set you build with our in-house lawyer, not with intuition. The work ships into a product lawyers rely on, and it is judged there.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* How we represent a large, changing body of law so a machine can reason over it and know what is currently authoritative.
* How we retrieve the right law with precision, where the answer can turn on a single fact, provision, or jurisdiction.
* How we verify that an answer is grounded in a real source that is still good law and catch it when it isn't.
* The legal eval set as the source of truth. You design the benchmarks and you own the number.
* The research direction. On a small team, you frame the problem, run the experiment, and make the call.

**THE HARD PROBLEMS YOU'LL TAKE ON**

* Representing law that changes under you. An authority that governs today can be overruled
* tomorrow, and the representation must know the difference.
* Proving groundedness at scale. A fluent answer citing a real sounding but wrong or dead authority is worse than no answer. Verifying grounding reliably is unsolved in this domain.
* Defining "correct" where experts disagree. Before you can measure a system, you must build ground truth in a field where correctness is argued, not given.

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR**

* Strong command of modern retrieval and representation: dense and sparse embeddings, vector
* and lexical search, rerankers, and when each win. You can build and evaluate a retrieval system end to end.
* Hands-on at the model layer for RAG and reasoning: prompting, structured extraction, and using
* LLMs as components of a larger system.
* Knowledge representation in practice: knowledge graphs, entity and relationship modelling, and
* using structure inside search and reasoning.
* Eval-driven for real: you design benchmarks, build datasets, and measure factuality and
* groundedness, not just offline accuracy.
* Comfortable where learned models meet symbolic or rule-based logic.
* Strong Python and rigorous experiment design, and you write clearly enough that an engineer can build from your spec.

**BONUS POINTS**

* A high-stakes domain where being wrong has real consequences: legal, medical, financial.
* Indian law, or Indian-language NLP.
* Information extraction and NER from messy documents.

title: Forward Deployment Engineer
description:
**About QuilrAI**

QuilrAI is a seed-stage cybersecurity company building the AI-driven, human-centric security layer for the modern enterprise, combining data loss prevention, AI security, and behavioral (UEBA) capabilities into a single platform. We work through a select group of national and regional partners including Guide Point Security, WWT, Trace3, and others, and we’re formalizing a partner program built for the way security is actually bought today: consultative, technical, and partner led.

We’re small, moving fast, and building something the channel is genuinely excited about. This role is a rare chance to help build a channel program from the ground up alongside the VP of Channel & Alliances.

**The Role**

The Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) works directly inside customer environments to deploy, adapt, and operationalize AI and Data security solutions. This role is deeply hands-on and customer-facing, focused on making AI, DLP, and Identity controls work under real-world constraints—often ahead of full product maturity. In addition to technical execution, the FDE plays a critical role in explaining architectural decisions, DLP limitations, and trade-offs to customer technical teams. You will combine hands-on deployment with clear technical storytelling and collaborative problem solving, helping customers understand not only what is being deployed, but why it works and where its boundaries are.

**What You Will Do**

• Deployment & Integration

· Deploy AI security solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises customer environments.

· Integrate AI agents and workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, and agent orchestration patterns involving human and non-human identities.

· Integrate identity and access management solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, OAuth, token enforcement, and service identities.

· Implement data protection and enforcement workflows, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) inspection, policy enforcement, and audit logging.

• Hands-On Engineering & Troubleshooting

· Develop custom scripts, connectors, and workflows using Python and Docker to support AI security deployments.

· Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across AI pipelines, agent workflows, identity flows, authorization boundaries, data movement, and policy enforcement points.

· Design and implement practical workarounds to address missing features, product limitations, and customer-specific technical challenges.

· Maintain deployment artifacts, scripts, and configuration files in GitHub to ensure version control and consistency across deployments.

• Customer Workshops & Collaborative Problem Solving

· Participate in and co-lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, and whiteboarding sessions during customer deployments.

· Collaborate with customer engineers and architects to refine AI access paths, define identity trust boundaries, and validate data protection and enforcement strategies.

· Identify environmental constraints, integration dependencies, and deployment challenges early to drive technical alignment.

• Technical Communication, DLP & Customer Alignment

· Explain AI security architectures and deployment designs, demonstrating how AI workflows, identity controls, and data protection mechanisms work together.

· Communicate where security enforcement occurs, identify enforcement limitations, and highlight potential coverage gaps.

· Lead technical discussions on DLP detection and enforcement capabilities, including the structural limitations of traditional DLP in AI-driven and agent-based workflows.

· Address common misconceptions about DLP coverage and help customers understand risk trade-offs, enforcement gaps, and compensating controls without overstating security capabilities.

• Feedback & Continuous Improvement

· Document deployment learnings, edge cases, technical challenges, and failure modes encountered during customer implementations.

· Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap, improve capabilities, and strengthen product reliability.

· Standardize successful deployment patterns, reusable configurations, and troubleshooting procedures to improve deployment efficiency across customer environments.

What We Are Looking For

**Required Qualification**

· Hands-on experience with AI/LLM systems, AI security architectures, and data protection mechanisms.

· Strong understanding of Data Loss Prevention (DLP), including data classification, content inspection, policy enforcement, real-world limitations, blind spots, and potential bypass scenarios.

· Solid knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM), including Single Sign-On (SSO), OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), token management, service identities, and policy engines.

· Proficiency in Python, Docker, and cloud-native technologies across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with familiarity in endpoint security and device trust integrations such as Microsoft Intune and Jamf Pro.

· Strong debugging, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and work directly with customers in high-stakes technical environments.

**Nice to have**

· Familiarity with AI agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain and LangGraph, including security considerations for agentic workflows.

· Experience integrating identity and access management solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, OAuth/OIDC, and service identities.

· Knowledge of AI security risks, DLP enforcement mechanisms, data leakage prevention, prompt injection, and agent permission boundaries.

· Experience with cloud security, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, and infrastructure-as-code tools across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* · Experience conducting customer workshops, technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept deployments, and documenting reusable integration patterns and deployment best practices.

You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside — review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for.

Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.
* We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.

description:
**Consultant - SAP Technical (Workflow)**
**About Invenio**

**Role: Consultant SAP ABAP (Workflow)**
**Years of Experience: 3-6**
**Location:**
**Shifts**
**Job Summary**
The Consultant – SAP ABAP is responsible for delivering end-to-end SAP technical solutions, including design, development, and implementation. This role requires strong hands-on expertise in ABAP, the ability to handle complex requirements, and active collaboration with functional and business stakeholders. The consultant is expected to work independently, contribute to project success, and mentor junior team members.
  
  
This position is specifically for SAP Business Workflow development. The consultant is expected to design, build and support approval and process-automation workflows, and to own live diagnostics of agent determination, deadlines and stuck work items.
  
  
**Key Skills**

* 3-6 years of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience, with at least 1-2 years of hands-on SAP Business Workflow development.
* Hands-on workflow development using Workflow Builder (SWDD) - tasks, steps, containers and binding, conditions, loops, forks and deadline monitoring.
* Business objects and ABAP classes used in workflow, event creation and linkage, and use of the event trace when a workflow does not trigger.
* Agent determination using rules, organisational structure and responsibilities; default, possible and excluded agents.
* Synchronous and asynchronous tasks and terminating events, and when each is the correct design.
* Workflow configuration and the background jobs that drive deadline monitoring and error recovery.
* SAP Fiori My Inbox integration, decision options and notifications.
* Flexible Workflow in S/4HANA - scenario activation, preconditions and step configuration.
* Production support - analysing work item logs, restarting errored work items, and resolving agent determination failures.
* Reports (ALV and classical), Data Dictionary objects, data migration programs, and enhancements using BAdIs, enhancement spots and user exits.
* Object-Oriented ABAP (Design Patterns) - classes, interfaces, inheritance and exception handling.
* Debugging, code optimisation and performance tuning.
* SAP development standards, unit testing, code review and transport management.
* Good understanding of code pushdown and how to write database-efficient ABAP on SAP HANA.
* ABAP Development Tools (Eclipse) along with SAP GUI - optional.

**Good to Have**

* BRF+ for agent determination and precondition logic.
* Attachment and document handling through Generic Object Services (GOS) and ArchiveLink.
* SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 awareness for end-to-end troubleshooting.
* SAP certification in ABAP.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse functional specifications and approval matrices, prepare technical designs, and raise gaps or clarifications before development starts.
* Validate escalation, substitution, delegation and deadline rules with the business before build starts.
* Develop, unit test and document workflows and supporting ABAP objects as per SAP development standards.
* Build workflows so that production behaviour is diagnosable - clear step descriptions and documented agent rules.
* Work with functional consultants and business users to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Own workflow production support - stuck and errored work items, agent determination failures and controlled restart.
* Resolve SIT, UAT and post-go-live defects within agreed timelines and record the correct root cause.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure quality standards are met before transport release.
* Prepare technical documentation and support knowledge transfer to the support team.
* Support the full project lifecycle including implementation and support.

**Business And Consulting Skills**

* Excellent oral and written communication; able to explain a technical position clearly and concisely.
* Understands business processes for the modules in scope and the touch points between them.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to research and work through detail.
* Ability to interpret requirements and apply SAP best practices instead of replicating legacy design.
* Aptitude for working in a team, strong time management, and collaboration with all levels of staff.
* Ability to work independently on assigned deliverables and guide junior team members.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent.
* At least one full-cycle SAP implementation or a substantial support and enhancement engagement.
* Experience on SAP S/4HANA - preferred.
* Willingness to travel to client locations and work shifts aligned to client geography.

**Equal Opportunity**
Invenio is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances. Invenio's management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, access to facilities and programs and general treatment during employment.

* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
