* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.

**About the job**
The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

title: Senior Manager - Database Administration
description:
**Job Summary:**

Owns the airline's database platforms and cloud data architecture on AWS. Designs purpose-built data solutions, runs resilient and cost-efficient database operations, and leads the move from traditional engines to managed cloud services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Cloud data architecture**

* Design data architectures on AWS using purpose-built services: Aurora and RDS (PostgreSQL, MySQL), DynamoDB, ElastiCache, Redshift and an S3-based data lake with Glue, Athena and Lake Formation.
* Select the right engine per workload on performance, resilience and cost; publish reference architectures and database standards.
* Plan and execute migrations from SQL Server, Oracle and self-managed MySQL to Aurora and RDS using AWS DMS and SCT.
* Design data integration with SaaS and line-of-business systems: CDC, event streams (Kinesis, MSK) and APIs.

**Database operations and resilience**

* Own availability, performance and capacity of production databases; lead P1 database incident response.
* Run high availability and DR: Multi-AZ, Aurora Global Database, cross-region replicas, AWS Backup and point-in-time recovery across the Mumbai and Hyderabad regions.
* Tune performance using Performance Insights, Enhanced Monitoring, execution plans and indexing.
* Plan patching and major version upgrades with minimal downtime, using blue/green deployments where supported.

**Automation, security and cost**

* Provision and change databases as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) with versioned schema pipelines
* Enforce encryption (KMS), secret rotation (Secrets Manager), IAM database authentication, least privilege and audit logging.
* Apply data protection controls for ISO 27001 and the DPDP Act 2023, including masking of non-production data.
* Drive database FinOps: rightsizing, Graviton instances, Savings Plans or reserved capacity and storage tiering.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Mentor and develop the Junior DBA as trained backup for routine operations.
* Partner with application, development and analytics teams on data models and query design.
* Manage AWS support cases and database vendor relationships.

**Skills and Experience:**

**Essential**

* Deep hands-on expertise with Aurora and RDS for PostgreSQL and MySQL, including replication, failover and parameter tuning.
* AWS data services: DynamoDB, Redshift, S3, Glue, Athena and DMS.
* Migration of SQL Server or Oracle workloads to open-source engines on AWS.
* Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting in Python or Bash.
* Strong SQL, data modelling and performance diagnostics.

**Advantageous**

* Streaming and CDC (Kinesis, MSK).
* Data warehouse and lakehouse design for reporting and analytics.
* Airline, travel or other high-volume transactional systems

**Qualifications and Certifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech or MCA in Computer Science or IT.
* Required: AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate with equivalent data platform experience.
* Preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, PostgreSQL professional certification.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
AI Platform Engineer
  
  
**Department**
: CEFS IT (CRM&S - CRM)
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
CIB
  
  
**Experience Required**
: 7+ years in software engineering, AI engineering or related fields (or equivalent proven experience)
  
  
**Product:**
AI‑Native CRM Platforms
  
  
**Position Purpose**
Looking for a highly skilled candidate with 7+ years of experience to join our dynamic development team as an AI Platform Engineer. In this role, the candidate will architect and deploy autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agentic systems designed to automate complex CRM+ application features and orchestrate multi-step processes across enterprise data. This is an exceptional opportunity for a candidate to drive innovation in Agentic AI, RAG pipelines, and LLMOps within a high-scale, regulated corporate and institutional banking environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and deploy autonomous and semi‑autonomous AI agents that automate CRM workflows (sales assistance, support automation, lead qualification) and orchestrate multi‑step processes across enterprise data. Implement permission‑aware tool adapters, bounded autonomy, guard‑rails, escalation mechanisms and full audit‑logging to satisfy AML and security compliance
* Build production‑grade Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that ingest structured and unstructured data, perform chunking, embedding, hybrid search, semantic retrieval, metadata filtering and re‑ranking using vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate). Create reusable LLM abstraction layers that support multiple model providers and open‑weight models, with model routing, fall‑backs, rate‑limiting, cost‑tracking and token‑consumption optimization (caching, context‑window management)
* Design and implement robust state & memory management for autonomous agents—handle checkpointing, persistent context storage, efficient serialization/retrieval, and scalable memory‑access patterns to support long‑running, multi‑turn interactions while maintaining consistency and compliance.
* Develop AI‑powered CRM capabilities such as customer profiling, lead qualification, meeting preparation, interaction summarization, follow‑up generation and next‑best‑action recommendation. Build natural‑language interfaces that let users query customer information, generate insights and trigger workflows conversationally. Enable agents to retrieve context, update CRM records and execute authorized actions while integrating LLM reasoning with business‑rule engines and existing CRM processes
* Engineer scalable backend services and APIs (Python, FastAPI, async) that expose agent functionality, integrate with CRM systems, databases, email/calendar services, document repositories and external APIs. Implement reliable execution patterns – background jobs, message queues, retries, timeouts, idempotency and fault tolerance – and construct event‑driven architectures with Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Design and operate AI‑infrastructure and LLMOps pipelines: containerize services (Docker), orchestrate on‑prem or cloud‑native Kubernetes clusters (Helm, Argo CD GitOps), manage CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and implement observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) together with model‑lifecycle tooling (MLflow, experiment tracking, model registry). Optimize latency, throughput, concurrency, resource utilization and inference cost; enforce access controls, tenant isolation, secrets management and audit trails.
  
  

* Provide technical leadership across product, engineering and compliance teams: own end‑to‑end architecture, prototype, productionise and maintain AI solutions; develop reusable frameworks and standards for agentic AI; conduct code and architecture reviews; mentor junior engineers; and continuously evaluate emerging agentic‑AI frameworks, models and deployment technologies for product relevance.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Proficiency in tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
* Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Familiarity with Oracle databases, Understanding schema, SQL
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Quick to learn and adapt
* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long-term commitment with the team and organization

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Agentic AI & Multi‑Agent Systems – Mastery of LangGraph / LangChain, tool‑calling, function‑calling, planning, task decomposition, state management, checkpointing, retries, human‑in‑the‑loop approval and performance metrics (completion rate, accuracy, latency, cost).
* LLM & RAG Engineering – End‑to‑end RAG pipeline design, context‑engineering, prompt optimization, grounding, hallucination mitigation, token‑window management, caching strategies and multi‑provider model routing.
* AI‑Powered CRM Capability Design – Ability to translate CRM domain expertise into intelligent features (profiling, scoring, summarization, recommendation) and embed LLM‑driven reasoning with rule‑engine and workflow automation.
* Backend & Integration Engineering – Delivery of high‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), secure API‑gateway configuration (Kong) and robust integration adapters that enforce permission models and idempotent behavior.
* Cloud‑Native & DevOps Practices – Deep experience with Docker, Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, Argo CD), CI/CD automation, Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki).
* Data & Retrieval Engineering – Proficiency with SQL/relational databases, vector‑search technologies, document processing, feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis), data‑quality governance, schema evolution and caching.
* Machine‑Learning Foundations – Practical knowledge of scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training/evaluation, hyper‑parameter tuning and lifecycle management with MLflow.
* Security, Governance & Compliance – Implementation of permission‑aware tool execution, audit logging, model governance and adherence to AML, GDPR and internal risk‑management policies.
* Performance Measurement & Optimization – Definition and monitoring of agent/LLM metrics (accuracy, latency, cost), systematic A/B testing and optimization techniques (semantic caching, prompt caching, context compression).

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with vLLM, LoRA/QLoRA fine‑tuning, quantization and GPU‑based model serving behind firewalls.
* Hands‑on work with LLM evaluation and tracing platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry or comparable tools.
* Advanced agentic‑AI patterns: durable execution, Model‑Context Protocol (MCP), persistent agent memory and sophisticated human‑in‑the‑loop workflows.
* Proficiency with common ML libraries (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) for rapid prototyping and model development.
* Knowledge‑graph expertise (Neo4j, Memgraph, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune, JanusGraph) for large‑scale network analytics and entity resolution.
* Experience with large‑scale streaming and batch processing frameworks (Kafka, Spark, Flink, Delta Lake) and data‑pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow).
* Familiarity with multi‑tenant SaaS architecture, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, SSO and enterprise identity‑management solutions.
* Background in recommendation, ranking, lead‑scoring, customer segmentation, forecasting or churn‑prediction models for CRM intelligence.
* Infrastructure‑automation expertise (Terraform, Pulumi, GitOps, Helm, Argo CD) and sandbox quota management for GPU nodes.

**Specific Qualifications:**
NA
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Core Programming & Software Engineering – Python, FastAPI/Flask, asynchronous development, REST/GraphQL APIs, SQL/relational databases, Git version control, automated testing, CI/CD best practices.
* Agentic AI & LLM Engineering – LangGraph/LangChain, tool/function calling, state & memory management, planning, task decomposition, multi‑agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, vector‑DB integration, prompt engineering, cost & rate‑limit controls, model routing.
* Backend & Integration Engineering – High‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), API‑gateway configuration (Kong), rule‑engine integration (Drools or custom), secure credential handling, idempotent design.
* Cloud‑Native & DevOps – Docker, Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, Argo CD GitOps), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI), IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki), secrets management, tenant isolation.
* Data & Retrieval Engineering – Structured and semi‑structured data handling, document ingestion & processing, embedding generation, vector‑search (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate), feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis), data lineage, quality and governance.
* Machine‑Learning Foundations – Scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training, evaluation, hyper‑parameter optimization, MLflow experiment tracking, model registry and artifact versioning.
* Collaboration & Problem‑Solving – Cross‑functional communication, stakeholder alignment, comprehensive documentation, mentorship, systematic troubleshooting and adaptability to regulated environments.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Collaboration & Communication – Proven ability to work in globally distributed, cross‑functional teams; translate complex AI concepts into actionable specifications; produce clear technical documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger, design specs); mentor junior engineers.

title: Architect - Data
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Data Architect**
**Exp Range :**
8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job location :**
Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Data Architect is the senior technical owner of the platform's design. You will define and evolve the architectural blueprint — the canonical data model, the ingestion framework, the transformation patterns, the FHIR serialization layer, the bidirectional flow with FHIR-Repository, and the governance and observability frameworks that hold them together. You will set the standards every other role implements against.
  
  
This role works in close partnership with the customer's existing Health Data Engine technical owners, who carry deep operational knowledge of healthcare data at scale. Architectural decisions are made in dialogue with them, anchored on real volume requirements and known operational pain points. You will be expected to defend choices with technical depth and adapt them when warranted.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture across ingestion (Flink + PySpark), storage (Iceberg on GCS with BigLake Metastore), transformation (dbt over Starburst), FHIR serialization (flat FHIR Iceberg → bundles → FHIR-Repository), and consumption (Starburst, FHIR API, data products). Maintain the architecture specification document and its companion design docs.
* Lead the design and evolution of the Common Data Model (CDM): the dimensional, fact, bridge, and reference table classes; SCD2 semantics; hash key conventions; the write-authority matrix that governs cross-source field precedence. CDM is the project's central design artifact and the architect owns it.
* Define the bidirectional FHIR flow with origin-tag-based loop prevention. Specify the FHIR repository egress interceptor contract, the loopback Flink consumer pipeline, and the boundary semantics between FHIR-repo-owned and CDM-owned fields.
* Define the patient identity resolution architecture using Informatica MDM, including the synchronous-call pattern at ingestion, the asynchronous ECI change event pipeline, and the DLQ taxonomy for MDM failures.
* Set the standards every other role implements against — naming conventions, hash algorithms (SHA-256 BINARY 32, 0x1F separator, NULL handling), Iceberg table properties (CoW vs MoR, partitioning, compaction cadence), DLQ taxonomy, observability (metric naming, structured logging, correlation ID propagation), and security (PHI handling, encryption, audit logging).
* Own the spec-driven development framework's program-level and component-level specs. Approve significant changes to platform-wide rules. Architect specs are the constitution every implementing engineer references.
* Drive the high-volume capacity design — sustained 50K msg/sec ingest target with 150K peak, billions of rows in CDM facts, thousand-concurrent Starburst workloads, thousands per second FHIR API. Lead capacity planning, validation, and the parallel-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine.
* Evaluate and recommend technology choices that are still open — Confluent Cloud tier, Starburst Galaxy vs Enterprise, FHIR-Repository sizing, multi-region failover topology. Build option analyses; defend recommendations with concrete trade-off matrices.
* Provide architectural review for engineering work. Review specs at the component and unit level when they touch architectural concerns. Mentor data engineers and data modelers on design principles.
* Lead architectural review meetings with customer technical stakeholders — including the Health Data Engine retirement team, governance, security, and clinical informatics. Translate complex trade-offs into language non-architect audiences can engage with.
* Establish and evolve the disaster recovery, backup, and reprocessing strategy across all platform layers. RPO under 5 minutes for streaming, RTO under 4 hours for full platform recovery.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 8+ years of data engineering experience with at least 3-5 years in a Data Architect or Lead Data Engineer role
* Deep expertise architecting and operating large-scale data platforms on Google Cloud Platform — Cloud Storage, Dataproc (specifically with Flink and Spark workloads), Cloud Composer, Secret Manager, Workload Identity, IAM, networking. BigQuery experience is useful background but is not used as the primary warehouse on this project
* Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg in production — table properties, partitioning strategies, snapshot semantics, schema evolution, CoW vs MoR write modes, compaction operations, and integration with metastore catalogs (BigLake, Glue, Polaris, or Nessie)
* Production experience with Starburst (Galaxy or Enterprise) or Trino for analytical workloads against open table formats. Understanding of query planning, predicate pushdown, partition pruning, and workload separation patterns
* Strong experience with streaming architectures using Apache Flink and Apache Kafka — stateful stream processing, exactly-once semantics, checkpointing, backpressure handling, and integration with Iceberg sinks
* Expert SQL and strong programming skills in Python. Familiarity with PySpark and PyFlink for batch and streaming respectively
* Deep experience with dbt — model materialization strategies, macros, tests, sources, exposures, project structure for large model graphs (hundreds of models). Specific experience with dbt-trino adapter is a strong plus
* Comprehensive understanding of healthcare data standards: HL7v2 (ADT, ORU, ORM message types and segment-level parsing), CCDA, and FHIR R4 with US Core 6.1 profiles. Experience with FHIR Bundle assembly, profile validation, and resource versioning semantics
* Hands-on experience with FHIR runtime platforms — FHIR-Repository or HAPI FHIR — including the interceptor framework, MDM module, and channel/subscription mechanisms
* Experience with master data management for patient identity resolution. Informatica MDM specifically is preferred; equivalent experience with Verato, NextGate, or QuadraMed translates
* Experience designing for HIPAA-regulated environments — PHI handling discipline, encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging conventions, BAA-relevant vendor decisions
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, make critical architectural decisions under uncertainty, and influence diverse stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* GCP Professional Data Engineer or Cloud Architect certification
* Experience with Atlan or comparable governance platforms (Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog)
* Experience with multi-region active-active or active-passive deployments on GCP
* Production experience operating Confluent Cloud at significant scale
* Familiarity with spec-driven development workflows, particularly with AI-assisted code generation
* Experience replacing or sunsetting legacy healthcare data platforms (Optum Health Data Engine, Innovaccer, Health Catalyst, Arcadia) is unique and highly relevant

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

The candidate will be responsible for providing technical support to customers and internal teams while proactively monitoring API health, performance, and error rates using tools such as Kibana, Databricks, Coralogix, and Grafana. The role involves investigating API failures, identifying root causes, configuring alerts, and managing incidents end to end while ensuring adherence to SLAs. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Postman, and command-line tools, along with the ability to leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot to automate repetitive tasks, streamline troubleshooting, and improve support efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* API Monitoring & Dashboard Management: Monitor API endpoints, logs, performance, and error rates using tools such as Kibana, Databricks, Coralogix, and Grafana. Build and maintain dashboards and visualizations to track API health and identify recurring issues.

Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java-based backend services and middle business layer components within enterprise full-stack applications. Direct Responsibilities

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Experience Level: 8+ years**

* 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale
* 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments
* Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills.
* Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React
* Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture
* Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

**Domain Experience**

* Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred
* Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous
* Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**
**Skill Group**
**Details**
**Core Java & JDK 21+**

* Modern language features – records, sealed classes, pattern‑matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional).
* Concurrency & Parallelism – virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives.
* JVM & GC tuning – G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‑dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‑system (JPMS) usage.
* Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
* Build & Unit‑test foundation – Maven/Gradle multi‑module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‑image awareness.

**Spring Ecosystem**

* Spring Boot 3.x – create micro‑service skeletons, auto‑configuration, actuator health‑checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2).,
* Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) – entity mapping, query‑hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation.
* Spring Cloud basics – service discovery (Eureka), API‑gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‑breaker (Resilience4j).
* Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration
* Spring Security– CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‑server setup, basic role‑based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS.

**Database & Data Access Engineering**

* SQL & query optimisation – complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‑plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL).
* Database optimisation - (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
* ORM performance – JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‑level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints.
* NoSQL & caching – when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‑aside), basic data‑modeling, and TTL/eviction policies.
* Migrations & transactions – Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‑DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‑level choices.

**Design & Architecture**

* Clean / Hexagonal architecture – ports‑and‑adapters, dependency‑inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring.
* Domain‑Driven Design basics – bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing.
* API‑first & contract – OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‑driven contract testing (Pact).
* Event‑driven patterns – Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‑box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation.
* Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security.
* Microservices design Pattern ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy
  
  

* Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions
* Caching Strategies (Redis, CDN)

**DevOps**

* Containerisation & K8s – Docker multi‑stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes.
* CI/CD pipeline – Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‑analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
* Observability starter – expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK.
* Runtime security, secret‑management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)
* Canary/blue‑green release patterns

**Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Test‑pyramid implementation – unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact).
* Performance & load testing – JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results.
* Static analysis & coverage – SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set.

**Frontend**
Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks.
  
  
**AI Tools**
Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas
  
  
Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design.
  
  
Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Sets technical direction for multiple squads and aligns it with business objectives
* Cross-functional collaboration across frontend, QA, DecvSecOps and infrastructure teams
* Balances speed, quality, and regulatory constraints in a fast-moving environment and is results oriented
* Ensures that security, data‑privacy, and regulatory requirements are baked in.
* Structured communication of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
* Adaptability to legacy and greenfield environments delivering modern, cloud‑native solutions.
* Leverages generative AI to boost productivity and foster a culture of experimentation

**Education Level:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS ProServe IN - Karnataka

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**
The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.
  
  
We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.
  
  
If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.
  
  
**Why this job’s a big deal**
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.
* CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
* Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production.
* Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.
* Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.
* Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**

title: Solution Engineer : Mumbai
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**domain-first, systems-oriented engineers**
who understand how real-world systems (in renewable energy
**,**
automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI-driven workflows using DevRev.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
**trusted advisor**
, combining
**domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem-solving**
to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients

title: Vice President, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Java Back-End Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global post-trade operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA) A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high-volume, real-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities Design and develop robust, high-performance back-end systems using Java 11+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event-driven systems to process and distribute large-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis-based caching and data stores for low-latency access patterns. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem-solving, and design thinking. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes. Qualifications / Competencies B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 8+ years of professional experience in Java and object-oriented design. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish-subscribe systems for real-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction. Nice to Have Experience with Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, or cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP). Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. Exposure to Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Back End Developer
description:
**Backend Engineer**

**RIVN Tech | Lower Parel, Mumbai | Full time | 5+ years of experience**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

RIVN Tech is looking for a hands-on Backend Engineer to take technical ownership of the backend services and infrastructure supporting our mobile application. You will build and maintain APIs, manage databases and AWS infrastructure, and keep payment integrations running reliably.

This role combines backend development with production support and technical coordination. You should be comfortable investigating issues across services, databases and infrastructure, making practical technical decisions, and working with frontend developers, internal teams and service providers.

**OUR TECHNOLOGY STACKS**

Backend: Node.js | Database: MongoDB | Cloud infrastructure: AWS

Payments: Paysafe | Mobile frontend supported by the backend: Flutter

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

·       Backend development: Build, maintain and improve Node.js services, APIs and business logic, taking work from requirements through testing, deployment and ongoing support. Work with Flutter developers to integrate backend functionality into the app.

·       Payments and wallet flows: Integrate and maintain Paysafe payment journeys, including deposits, withdrawals and transaction status updates. Handle failed or pending transactions, secure callbacks and webhooks, duplicate requests, and reconciliation between payment records and wallet balances.

·       AWS operations: Manage application hosting, environment configuration, deployments, monitoring, access permissions and backups. Troubleshoot availability and performance issues, and monitor infrastructure costs.

·       Database management: Maintain MongoDB data models, indexes, queries and access controls. Manage migrations, data integrity, backups and recovery procedures.

·       Quality and security: Write maintainable code, review changes and test critical backend and payment flows. Maintain authentication, authorisation, input validation, secure credential handling and appropriate protection of user and payment data.

title: Senior Consultant - Middleware/OCP
description:

* Hands on experience using Cloud as a development environment

* Working with application and infrastructure monitoring
* Experience with or knowledge of JavaScript, Golang, Python, or Shell Scripting
* Experience with or knowledge of technologies AngularJS, React.js, and Vue.js

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

description:

**What We’re Looking For**

* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation.
* Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams.
* Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation.

**Desirable Experience**

* Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.
* Exposure to HFT, electronic trading, execution, order-book or market-microstructure data.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput data systems.
